dialog.text: I won my fight today.
nice! do you feel better? I know you've been losing some fights recently.
I am. I am really trying to learn from those loses, and it seems to be paying off in practices. AND TODAY! What a fight!!!
That's exciting! Was it a close fight or did you dominate haha

You had to ask, didn't you?! I jest. But it was very close. I was worried I was going to lose at first, but I just stayed focused and in the moment. It really is all about trusting your instincts and not getting in your own way.
That is true.  A win's a win.  I'm glad you didn't get into your own head when it was close... maybe you'll be able to get some more wins after this.
I sure hope so. This fight paid $5,000!
that's amazing! I wouldn't have expected it to pay that much.  Maybe I should get into fighting haha

Hahahaha the money can be good. It really depends on the tournament. Or private hirings, like parties, they pay well, but some odd people throw those parties. Today was great though! I am definitely looking forward to some R&R tonight!
you really deserve it.  Maybe just relax and listen to some country music tonight.
Hahaha maybe some old Swift and a bubblebath. My muscles will be hurting tomorrow. My opponent was good!
That sounds really relaxing.  If you were able to beat them then you should be able to beat your next opponents too!

dialog.text: What kind of dogs do you have?
One is a terrier and one is a sheep dog.   How long have you been volunteering?
I have been volunteering for last 7 years
Nice.  I try to, but I've been working on the two Mustangs.  One is a 68 and the other is a 66 Hertz clone.
What are doing with those two?
The 68 is a daily driver, at least during the summer.  The Hertz clone is a trailer queen.  I'm too afraid of paying for on  the road insurance.
How long have you been doing this?
Ummmm, off and on, since 1989.  It's a hobby that takes a lot of devotion.  It can be expensive, but it doesn't always have to be.
This sounds fun. Do you have any other hobby?
Well I do like to listen to classic country, and I do have my two dogs, "Baron Zemo" and "Spike."   What about you, how do you like wrestling as your day job?
I'm not super into wrestling.
Ah, now that makes sense.  I guess it's like an engineer that doesn't like to fix stuff around the house.  Well, work is work, I guess.

dialog.text: How's work on the Mustang coming?
Not so good, I got bit by one of my dogs and needed stiches in my hand so haven't been able to make much progress.
I'm so sorry to hear that! How on earth did that happen?
Just a little rough housing that went a bit too far.
That's unfortunate. I'm hoping you'll make a speedy recovery! What's your day job?
I'm a dog trainer!  I guess I'm not that good
Haha well I suppose no one is perfect. Given my recent string of lost matches, I can't say I'm doing much better.
Yeah between the both of us, could probably get a country song written about our distresses...perhaps Taylor Swift could perform it.
That would be a chart-topper, I'm sure. Something to blast while driving with the top down, maybe even in your next restoration project.
Yes!! Can't wait to get back in the saddle with the restoration.  One of the one's I am working on is a convertible.
Sweet! I'm sure that will be an amazing ride once it's finished. How long does a project take to complete, generally speaking?
For me, I can usually do a full restoration in 6 months if I put in a few hours a day after work.

It has been busy! I volunteered at the homeless shelter this morning. Do you do any volunteering?
Sadly not. I admire those who do though! Work keeps me so busy, and then I spent time on my car to relax. How did you get into wrestling as a job?
I work out a few times a week and a trainer came over and asked if I was interested in wrestling and gave it a go! Have you ever wrestled?
No I haven't, I think I'd be terrible at it! Does it take you a long time to recover? It looks so physical and exhuasting!
No different in my opinion then working out at the gym, keeps your mind focused! You should try it sometime, I think you would like wrestling!
I can definitely see how it would be cathartic, although I'm so worried about getting my ass whooped I'm sure I'd be terrible. But it's all about working up a sweat, right?
Yes, getting beat is not a highlight but makes you want to train even harder! And working up a sweat is no joke! Ha ha.
I definitely respect the mental stamina needed, too. I could learn some more of that, sometimes working on my car gets me so frustrated I can't stand it, ha!
I can see that. I have attempted to work on cars, I don't have the patience for it! I need to keep moving!
It's definitely an acquired thing. The word needs mechanics and wrestlers, ha!

dialog.text: Have you thought about looking into community college classes as a starting point to study economics? It could be a good way to get some of the basic courses taken care of at a lower price.
That's a very good suggestion.  I haven't looked into anything recently, so I'll need to stop procrastinating.  How long did it take you to get your Economics degree?
I had to work days, so I took classes at night for 8 years. I'd love to go on for an MBA, but it would take me another 8 to get there.

Yeah I can imagine how tough that was for you.  I'll probably need to do the same and find a college nearby since I don't have a car.  Would you say the job prospects for an Economics major will still be good 4-6 years from now?
I think so. You say you don't want to study anything to do with medicine, but I would think the economics of healthcare and hospitals would make for an interesting study.
I'll definitely consider it.  Did it take you long to find your new job after graduation?
I quit my day job thinking I would be hired right away, but then had to go to work at nights in the university hamburger and pizza bar for six months before I found the right position.
Yeah, but how exciting it must be for you now.  New job and new home.  Have you decided how you would like to decorate your new place?

Heh, whatever the wife and kids want! Seriously, my wife interned with a fairly well-known interior decorator for three years right after she graduated high school, so I'm gonna leave it up to her. It is exciting!
Maybe the people in your couponing group can help you find deals on furniture and other things around the house since money is tight.

Now that's an idea, thanks! I expect a bonus after my six months on the job too, and that's three months from now.  Should be substantial enough to buy some additional furniture... IF my wife's expensive tastes can be toned down a little.
Haha.  That's so cool that you're getting a bonus so soon on the job.  Sounds like a great company to work for.

dialog.text: I've heard they're making a new Stephen King adaptation - I bet I end up going to see it!
Yeah, I am trying to get in on that one! I want to be in one of his movies because they are bomb!

So cool. Where I live they filmed the Shawshank Redemption.  I know some people who were doubles in it. I love horror but true crime is my favorite thing to read. What kind of books have you read so far this year? Any you recommend?

Oh yeah. I read this one book called The Butterfly Garden by Dot Huchinson. It was very dark and disturbing, but it was true crime/fiction. And it is still haunting me. It is a book in her collectors series. I have not yet been able to get myself to read the others in that series because it hit me pretty hard.
Wow. That sounds like something I would really love. I just finished a book myself this morning about a serial killer. Do you read your books through Kindle? Or check them out from the library?

I have kindle unlimited and the libby app, but I believe that particular one was on Kindle Unlimited. It was about teenaged girls being kidnapped and locked in a giant jar and turned into butterflies permanently after the man and his son had their way with them. So I had to lay off her books for a bit. Oh! I also read Billy Straight. that was on libby from my library. It is AMAZING. and it is a true crime story! What was the book you read?

I have never heard of the Libby app. I'll have to check that out. I use Kindle because I have Amazon Prime and there are a ton of free books to find that way. The book I read was called Fatal Charm. It was about a husband who murdered two of his wives staging it to look like accidents each time. I hope to find another similar one to read next. What was Billy Straight about?

Billy Straight is about a runaway kid that goes to hollywood and pretends to be in school but lives in a park. He witnesses a high profile murder and the cops are searching for him, thinking it was like an old bag lady, but confused as to why the possible witness had a presidents book wrapped in plastic out there. I have Amazon Prime as well. The first book I mentioned may be available on Prime reading. The libby app is an app where you can use your local library card to borrow books virtually and read them on your kindle.
Oh ok. I have used other type of apps where it syncs up with the library number to check books out. I really love that option when checking out books now. Makes it so easy and convenient!

Yeah it does! I am so happy to have someone to talk about books with! Not many people that I know appreciate them as much as they should. Plus everyone always wants to know what cool stunts I have been a part of, they forget that my favorite hobby  is reading everything ever written haha.

You never know, with everything you have done in your past, I might read a book about YOU eventually! I can't even imagine what interesting stuff you'd be able to put in a book like that. My life is pretty monotonous so there wouldn't be much to put in a book about me.

I mean, you said you like Stephen King. And Shawshank. I read that book. It was pretty boring. But it was also amazing. You never know what someone else might like to read. Also, doing stunts isn't always fun or exciting. Sometimes it is just falling off a roof and having to lay up for 7 weeks over a broken ankle. Nobody wants to hear about binge reading all of Jeff Wheelers books!

dialog.text: What other books have you read in your life that really stand out to you?
Dr Seuss' Old Hat New Hat has always resonated with me.  Are you familiar with it?
Haha I think I may have read it years ago as a kid. Remind me what it's about?

A character is shopping for hats and trying all types of hats on and none are suitable until he finds his old hat which he had taken off when he entered the hat store.  Not an actual classic, but lots of fun.
Well my son is probably too old for it at this point, but I might volunteer to read it for the kids group at the library!
I often take it out when I am having a rough day at work...it is mindless fun.  Almost as much as the stunt double work I just did.
That sounds like an incredible amount of fun, but anything but mindless! What was your last stunt gig?
I stood in for the actor who is playing Rocky Balboa in a remake of the original Rocky movie.
Wow, I'm super impressed! Tell me, what sorts of stunts do you have to do for this one? My imagination is running wild.
Just imagine getting punched over and over again!
Oof, talk about working hard for the money! Hopefully you're getting free visits to a massage therapist as part of the package!
Only the real stars get that treatment.  The stunt doubles get old coffee and donuts in the trailer.

dialog.text: Does your college have a dorm? Mine just called, I forgot I was even on the waiting list, and I get to move out! Check into it okay?

Oh wow, that sounds great! I'm envious that you're able to move out. I can't move out. My college has a dorm but I'm not able to move out for now. Do you think you'll be able to concentrate on your studies while living in a dorm?
I have always loved to study, so that should not be a problem. I don't like to party, I do want to hang out and maybe have a few video game or movie nights
Maybe I can come visit you in your dorm room so I feel more like I'm in college and not living with my parents. Do you think you'll try to form a study group?

Oh yes. I am all about meeting to study together. I have not had one in a year or two, but we used to do like every week a different person would get their parents to buy lunch or dinner, depending on when the meeting was. Like now, I guess that it would have to be one of us haha. But we would have like pizza and pop or burgers and fries. One girl always brought edible arrangement fruit bouquets and those were amazing! We all loved her day. They came with like caramel and yogurt fruit dip! Would you consider joining a group like that?

Oh yes, that would be great! I'd love to join a group like that. I feel like that would really make me feel like I'm part of a group and not just going to class every day and going back to my parent's hosue.

We can even have slumber parties to watch a movie after if the dorm allows sleeping over. Idk, I have to find out. But like a once a week slumber party with food and a movie would be amazing! And I have access to HBO Max, so we can watch a newly released movie without having to pay for it like once or twice a month!
Oh wow!  That's great! That sounds like a ton of fun. Studying turned into fun, who would've thought! I'm sure the dorm room would allow I would think.

I hope so! Now I am more excited! We have to decide what subjects we can study together and which ones we will have to like just help out with. Like if you are taking algebra, then I can help, but I am taking a higher math. But if we are both taking BIO, we can study that together!

That sounds good, I'm definitely taking BIO right now. It's honestly kind of a waste of time though because it's not my major but pre-requisites suck. I wish they weren't a thing at all. Seems like a waste of money.

Yeah. I am working on getting my childhood education degree concentration in my favorite subject, math. But I have to take English and Bio and Art. I won't be teaching any of that so IDK why they are forcing me to take them. But I like to learn so. Oh well I guess.
I know, don't you hate that? But like you said, I like to learn too! Just lots of money.

dialog.text: I think I might plan a trip to Germany to sample some more of their white wines.
Wow. If you can, do it. Try some reds for me. Are you going solo?
I'm thinking of taking my brother with me.  I'm scared to go alone.  Maybe you could come along too!
I am not sure I would be able to stand the long flight! Who knows what percentage of my remaining days that would take up. You two will have a great time!
that's true.  maybe i can bring back some wine for you.
Now, THAT is a good idea. I will take a barrel, please! Do you know where in Germany you want to go?
I'm not sure.  I know that I want to visit Auschwitz for sure.  I'm really interested in history.
Oh, you definitely should. We cannot forget the past. It is scary how often we see history repeating itself. I am glad you are using this trip to educate and experience (as will as drink!).
That is true.  I'll be sure to share everything with you when I get back.
Thank you. I appreciate it. Will you be able to stay in touch while you are away?

I spend a lot of time at the ocean and I love the mountains.  You could visit Sequoia National Park, Yosemite and the Redwoods.  I used to camp there every year.

That's an excellent idea! Once I retire, I'll need to catch up with people easily somehow. It's time I learn how to Facebook.

But I think it's something everyone should experience and decide for themselves. Maybe you could come visit out in Colorado, someday?
I would have to ask and even then I don't know if I would be allowed. Just typing on the computer is making me nervous. I do not know how I would feel surrounded by things like this

dialog.text: How was harvesting today?  And was your pet cow in a good mood?  What is their name?
Pet cow is Mabel, she like to lay in the shade.  Harvest was not that good, had a big issue with Chinese lantern flies this year.
I also like to lay in the shade, just like your pet cow, Mabel! How does a pet cow differ from a regular dairy cow, if you don't mind me asking?
At a certain point, dairy cows cease to produce milk...my preference is to turn them into pets as opposed to dinner!

Sounds like you have a soft spot for animals! I couldn't agree more, I also did some farm work a few years back. We herded cattle using a herding dog, and a four wheeler. Pretty much just moved them to different pastures. Have you ever had to help deliver calves?
As an Amish farmer, I have done it all.  Have delivered calves, goats, sheep, foals...you name it.  All by hand here in Lancaster County!
Having grown up in Amish country, are you yourself Amish?
Yes, of course.  It's not an easy life, but an honest one that I am proud of.

Wow! What an incredible amount of dedication you have! I absolutely admire that in today's world, you are staying true to your culture. Was being Amish a decision that you freely made or were you born into it?
Was born into it. In some ways I think we Amish folk have it easier than you English folks.  We refer to all outsiders as "English".
I envy your choice to live off the grid! No news, no technology? What language do you speak?
English of course, and a dialect of German known as Pennsylvania Dutch.  It's similar to real German.

Yeah I would of thought so it must be a lot faster these days with all the heavy machinery around.

It's nice to see a communtiy sticking to their roots,I think modern technology is destroying the old ways these days.

No i'm but I would love to be in a close knit community the world feels so distant these days.

No I haven’t. I should though I need to do something to get my mind off of all the stress I’ve been having. We still are having a hard time coping with my dad. Do you do yoga?
Yes, I like to do yoga to get away from all the stress of my kids and life. It's great "me" time where I can turn off for 30 minutes or an hour. You and your mom can try it together.

I will recommend it to her. Sounds like it might help. I don’t know how you do it with five young boys at home, you must really have your arms full with all of them. Any of them showing interest in basketball?
They really have no choice or they get sent to the scorpion pit! haha I am kidding, but they all play in some form or another. Do you like basketball?
I used to play but not too much. I like just shooting around and playing for fun. Maybe I can come watch your team play sometime soon. When is your next game?
Next Friday! You should come and bring your mother. It might be a good distraction. I usually have everyone over for pizza afterwards as well, it will be fun.
Sounds good. Maybe we can play board games after too. I’m sure your boys would like that.
I am sure they would! Maybe you could bring some of your favorite games with you to introduce to us?
I have a few new ones I’d like for them to try. Just make sure the scorpions stay in the basement!
Don't worry, they will stay away! What games would you like to play? Also, what kind of pizza toppings do you and your mother like?
We like supreme and meat lovers pizza. Anything but pineapple. I have a new war board game you might like. It’s a lot like risk but a little different.

dialog.text: You know, I am enjoying to work inside!  I got that job!
That's great news! Was it the IT job? I was hoping you'd get it.
Yes I did!! Thank you for your encouragement! How is your work going?
Oh, it's about the same, pays the bills. I decided to start an herb garden this year, along with my vegetable garden. Are you going to start a garden this year or have you given up on that idea?

I'm still getting used to the structure of this new job, especially after going so long unemployed. I definitely asked about flexibility with the schedule, and if I could start later in the day so I'd have time to garden first like you suggested. Since I'm the newest hire, I think they are a little stricter on scheduling and whatnot, but hopefully as I gain experience and benefits, I'll have more flexibility there. That's awesome about the herb garden! What kind of herbs are you thinking about?

Basil, some mints, rosemary, cilantro and thyme to start. Mints are easy to grow, no way you could kill those haha. But you have to keep them under control or they'll take over. You might want to start with those. And I'm sure you'll settle into the routine of working soon.
I'll definitely keep that in mind!! Have you been busy with anything else outside of gardening? Any more organized events for women's rights coming up?

Yes I'm working on putting together a fundraiser. With all that's going on in the southern states right now it's important to keep busy on the issue. Don't go buying lottery tickets with your increased salary, now. I know how you like to gamble. Have a little fun but put some in savings.
I'll definitely put some in savings? What kind of fundraiser? Are you going to sell some of your veggies? You can count me in to donate some funds, now that I've got a job!
Oh that's very kind of you! We have a raffle, a bake sale and a t-shirt sale to raise money for an upcoming rally in the fall. I'm baking carrot muffins for the sale with some of my garden carrots.
In my mind, a raffle is just as good as the lottery. I'll take a few tickets. Carrot muffins and carrot cake is one of my favorites!
I should have known you'd jump on that raffle, haha. We're raffling off a macbook someone donated, perhaps you can use it in your new job. I'll save you a muffin too.

Of course, I drive a Ford F150 myself and I would highly recommend it. It has good hauling power and a very powerful engine. In any case, try getting a truck with 4WD if you can.
That's what I have now and I tow a little bit so it would be helpful to continue that. Do you use your truck on the farm a lot?
Definitely, it is a must have if you work on the farm. I use it to transport farming material, sometimes even livestock if other transport vehicles are occupied.

I'm sure you could, however I always recommend using a more specialized vehicle if you can. Are you particularly interested in having a truck with more bed space or a bigger cabin?
A bigger cabin, I think... What would you recommend? I don't do a ton of transport so I think the cab would be more beneficial.

If you don't transport often, a bigger bed isn't really necessary. Its usually better to have a bigger cabin, so more people can be in the car. I know it would be great if more people could carpool with me as I drive my truck.
That would be nice. My gas mileage isn't great. I wish I could carpool so it wasn't so wasteful.

It can be depending on what time of day you go. I would not go at night because there can be dangerous wildlife such as snakes and mountain lions.
That might make you move faster though! haha Just kidding. But I hope you find some people to do it with you. Safety in numbers and all that.
Yep, it's normally pretty safe during the day though. I hope that when my kids are older they same my same passion for the outdoors, I would love for them to join me when they are older.
That would be very nice for you.  How is your step-mother doing? I know that it must be hard to watch her suffer.

She has good days and bad days. We just try to be patient with her and enjoy her on her good days when she feels up to it. Our remaining time is limited. Have you ever had to go through something like that before?
Just with my own scare.  I was fortunate though and it was caught early.  I'd like to make a sampler or a pillow for her, if you think she'd like it.  Something encouraging.
I think she would love that. She has come to realize that she does not have much time left, so any interaction or showcase of love is very precious to her.
I'm sure it is. Bless her!  I'm trying to teach my grandkids to be more compassionate for other people.  They seem so self-absorbed.
I think that is natural for kids, they are just so focused on living in the moment, so distracted by what is going on in those little minds!
Yes, it takes time for them to learn not to be so absorbed in what they want above all else.  I try not to meddle to much, but my kids sometimes don't seem to understand and give in to them too much.

dialog.text: Thank you so much for teaching me pottery, I have bought my own supplies now so I can practise at home.
That's so awesome, you'll have to send me pictures of your finished works! I made a vase today, I used an acid etching pattern on the glazing. Not perfect, but it still looks nice. How's Elsa doing?
Elsa is doing well, she's so sweet. I'm throwing a dog bowl for her on the pottery wheel. It was supposed to be a face, but it looked more like an ashtray.  I'm not very good at this yet.

Keep practicing! You'll get better. Elsa does look like a sweet pup. I can't wait to have a dog of my own. I wish my dad would lighten up a bit and get me one. Is Elsa ready for the upcoming competition?
I think I'm more nervous than she is.  She loves practicing the course especially.  I think she'll do well.   Well, maybe if you try harder to get your chores done, your dad will change his mind.
Chores! I need to focus on my art - it will be my career one day and I have to perfect it. Have you been dancing lately? I've never been to a dance.
Lately, I've had to forgo the dance clubs lately. These days I'm only dancing with Elsa! I'm sure you'll be going to lots of dances once you are in high school!
Maybe. Dancing sounds fun, but not if it's with boys. I'd rather dance with Elsa too! When she wins that competition - and I know she will - you need to send pics and videos!
I certainly will!  But I bet you change your mind about the boys  in a couple of years when they start fighting over you!
no, boys distract girls from important stuff like art. They need to wait in line behind the pottery. Have you decided to stay a blond?
I'm thinking about going back to my natural color, and just bleach the tips. What do you think?
I think your black hair is beautiful. I wish I had hair like that. But you have to do what you like best. bleached tips sounds fun.

dialog.text: My marathon training is going really well, yesterday I ran half marathon
That's fantastic. Did it feel amazing after everything you went through?
It did! It felt really good to be back to the level of fitness I was at before pretty much. I still have a bit to go but it gave me confidence.
So when is your full marathon?
It is at the end of next month so I have about 5 weeks or so to prepare. I'm hoping to at least finish even if my time isn't great.
That's a great attitude. I really need to get my own fitness back up to what it was when I was a kid. What would you suggest?
I'd start with something easy, maybe just start going for long walks around your local park and you can build up from there.
That's a good idea. Small, simple steps seem to be better. What about nutrition? It's so hard when I'm traveling.
Yes it is very important you should try and follow some simple recipes to try and prepare your own food. Maybe start with a simple stirfy?
Is there a better way to learn than just looking up recipes? That always ends up in disaster for me. I just cannot seem to learn to cook.
Maybe you could see if there are any local cooking classes. Or failing that sign up for a meal subscription service - then you just need to reheat the meals.
That's a really good idea for when I'm home. It's hard when I'm sailing though. Maybe I can make some progress at home. What kind of salads do you usually do?

You dont need to.. OK let's start with a brisk walk . we can get a subway sandwich on the way . They have loads of healthy food

That'd be great. I am sorta ashamed of it. I used to be in pretty decent shape, then life and other things took over and before I knew it I was huge haha.

Anything that involved cardio really! I couldn’t do any of it now to save my life, but one day at a time is how I’m taking it. How is training for your marathon going?
it is going well, I am going to easily do the marathon. Maybe not a good time but I will complete it. I thought that sailing was hard work? Does it not keep you fit?
I guess it does but indulging in good food is what keeps from losing any weight. I am finishing up repairs on my boat soon, would you like to come next week since you never been?
Sure, I have never been sailing before. Maybe I could help you learn to cook some healthy good food?
That would be amazing, I have been trying to cook up something new everyday but have yet to cook something edible. What are your specialties?
I like to make most of my meals around vegetables. You can eat as much as you want but I can make it so you do not feel like you are missing out.

Roasted Mediterranean vegetables are the best!

My parents were always into sports and healthy. I just picked it up from them really.
Well that is amazing! I think you would be a great asset for when I start a healthier lifestyle!

dialog.text: How did your sons baseball practice go?  More organized this time?
A little bit, but not much better. I think I might be a terrible coach
Don't be too hard on yourself.  Getting kids that age to focus can be really difficult.  You'll figure it out.
I appreciate the optimism, I thought organizing my sons practices would help me coach little league, but its not working like I thought
I imagine coaching takes a lot of patience.  I know when my boys were young and in sports they drove their coaches crazy.
Do you remember how their coaches dealt with it or did they just deal with it?

The best coach they have had, just broke things down into the simplest possible parts, then got them to focus on what part at a time.  One time I remember they spent the whole practice bunting.  Other coaches just yelled a lot, which didn't help.
I try not to yell, but sometimes I get frustrated and it seems like that is the only thing that they respond to

If you hear them groaning, it probably means you are doing something right.  If they are groaning, it means you have got their attention.  The year they had that coach they won the league championship on a suicide bunt!
What? No way! What a team way to win. Your kids winning the championship must have been so fun. I can only imagine what it is like to win as a coach
I'm sure you'll get the chance to find out!  You care about coaching, and that's the most important thing.
Thanks, talking to you has really helped. I'm ready to get back out there tomorrow and do my best for the kids

dialog.text: What type of photos do you learn to take in photography class?
We've learned a lot of different types actually! Most recently we've been working with candid photography
That sounds like fun!  I'm always amazed at picture people take!  Photographers are so talented!  All artists are!  I am awful at any kind of art!
You should try photography sometime! I promise it's nothing like painting.  Maybe we can go out to the city sometime and take some candid urban shots together?
That would be fun!  I always see cool murals on the sides of coffee shops and always think street art would be a cool thing to photograph!
Awesome! Are you free this weekend, or do you have to work? It's my husband's turn to deal with the kids on Saturday, so I'm free.
I'm free!  You'll have to pick me up in the mini-van though since I still haven't gotten a car!  How are your boys doing these days?
The boys have been a handful lately (as always), but on the whole I love them so much.  They've just got a lot of energy now that it's starting to get warmer outside.
At least they'll be able to get outside more!  Do all give of them play baseball?

The older ones do, and I think the youngest will start in a year of two when they're able.  It certainly makes things easier being able to take them all to the baseball diamond and just letting them play on their own.  Organizing their team practices on the other hand is a nightmare...

I can't even imagine trying to coach little ones!  How old are the ones you coach? I remember when mine were little and played sports!  The attention span was awful!  They'd be in the field picking flowers while a ball rolled past them!

I've coached ages ranging from 6 to 11.  There's definitely a lot of variability in terms of skill.  Some of them are really into it and very talented, others can struggle to pay attention.  It's always a crapshoot what the team is going to look like.

I think so.  Have you thought about getting back into painting?
Well I have been considering photography - there is alot of amazing street art near me and I think they would make great prints. Any tips for me?
Lighting is important but just having fun with it is more important.  Keep clicking until you get the shot you like.  What is the street art about?
There is so much of it and it's all very different. There is a whole part about climate change near by with gorgeous scene of wildlife and nature. What is your favorite thing to photograph?

Oh that sounds lovely.  I love to photograph nature and the sort of stillness in it.  Sunrises, a butterfly on a flower, things like that.  I will take a photo of anything though, always have my camera with me. My boys always make fun photography subjects. Have you heard from your children?
I think to start out I should try to photograph lots of different things to see what works! Unfortunately not, I was hoping they might call this weekend but no :(
That's a great idea.  When we get together this weekend, you will get a feel for it.  Oh, that's a shame.  They may be busy, have you tried calling them?
Yes, I am looking forward to getting all your advice! No, I normally always phone them but I get the sense  it's an inconvenience so I don't bother anymore.

Oh. I am sure your not an inconvenience.  But I understand always being the one to call...people seem to forget a phone call works both ways. Was thinking we could get something for lunch this weekend...what do you like to eat?

It was my telephoto lens that I just got. It was quite expensive but I had purchased the insurance so should be able to replace it without out of pocket costs.
That must be a relief. I would feel so bad if that happened to me. Can you work with other lenses in the mean time?

I can, but was excited to get some new shots of things that I haven't been able to capture before.  There is an eagle nest with eaglets that I am trying to photograph.  Can't do it without the lens that I just cracked!
That must be disappointing. Do you develop your own photos as well?
I would love to develop my own photos, but with five kids, I don't have enough rooms in the house for a dark room.

Nah, they enjoy sports and videogames.  Shocking right??
Hahha. Do they play on any organized teams?
Hmmm, that is an interesting question...I organize their team practices, but I can assure you they are not always organized.  Sometimes it feels like I am just corralling cats.

dialog.text: I started my job and I am loving it so far.

Generally speaking, I keep in contact with them via E-mail or phone and do a weekly or bi-weekly meet up to make sure they are on the right track. If you want to try it out, I can get you scheduled with me or another agent for a free month trial.
Oh that would be awesome! I'd totally try it for a month. Not sure if it's for me but there's no harm in giving it a shot. Especially with the baby coming soon, I need to make sure my life's in order

It's not due for another 4 months, so I'd be happy to get an appointment sooner! I have a kayaking trip I'm busy planning for right now, but maybe in 2 weeks if there's something available?

Ah that makes a ton of sense, they seem like similar jobs at least in some respects. Encouraging people and helping them meet their goals. You should totally try kayaking! It's super versatile, it can be relaxing on a lake or thrilling doing whitewater
I've always been interested in Kayaking but never really had the opportunity to get in to it. Do you think you could help teach me a bit and maybe we could go on a day of kayaking together?
Yeah that would be so fun! It's really easy honestly, there's a bit of skill with steering but once you get the hang of it it feels super natural.

Are you sure you want to do it? I can definitely teach you the basics if you are willing to go with me on my next trip.

Yeah definitely! I feel like water sports are the final frontier for me when it comes to athletics.  It also seems like a great way to forge bonds with clients.  How late in your pregnancy do you expect to keep kayaking?

I'll keep going until I feel like I can't do it anymore. So, who knows really? Anyway, do you want to start out kayaking by doing something calm (like a lake) or should we aim for a river with rapids?
Hmm, do you think it'd be easier for me to learn the techniques in calmer water?  Or is it better to jump straight to rapids since that's where I want to end up eventually?
I think it would be better to start out in calm water. Once you have been able to practice the basics for a bit then we go to moving water. I think you'll be fine though.

That sounds reasonable, I definitely want to make sure I really know what I'm doing if I'm going to be kayaking with this client later on.  It'd be a bad look for me to not have the fundamentals down before I meet with them.
Did you ever get your kayak that you were talking about buying? If not, I have one that you can borrow for the trip.
I haven't bought anything yet, I was going to hold off until I tried it first to make sure I could do it.  It'd be wonderful if you'd let me borrow one!  Are you sure it'll fit me? Haha
Yeah, it'll fit you no problem. I suppose it's a good idea to wait. You don't know yet if you are going to want a kayak for calm waters or for rapids.
Okay cool, do you know which calm lake we can go to?  I'm not very familiar with the places around here that allow kayaking.
There is a pond/lake up by where my trip is going to be. It's also not far from where the river is located. It'll be a great time!

dialog.text: Are you studying on your own right now?
Yes, I am.  Studying on my own is better so I don't get distracted.  I have finals next week so I'm studying a lot.
I see you don't like to study much or like school work, how come?
Whenever I study with my classmates, they end up changing the topic and we don't get any studying done.
Oh I see, have you ever tried to write down specific topics and try to follow the topics?
I usually rewrite my notes.  Is that what you mean?
Yes, I find that to be helpful, it might be helpful for your classmates as well.
How would that work in a group study session?
Each member of the group writes down what topics they would like to talk about and one by one each topic will be talked about. This way no one gets off track into random topics.
How do you stop people from talking about their day, for example?
I would remind them that this is a study session and after the study session we can talk about personal business/plans. Its important to keep school and personal life separate.

I'm so sorry to hear that, but I'm glad everyone is mostly okay. Have you thought about going back to school? It's tough to work and to go to school, but I hope it will be very rewarding.

That's a good idea too, I hadn't thought about it but a change of industries might just be right for you. I don't have a lot of free time between my job and schooling, but it's going well, thank you. It's frustrating to not have much time to do the things I would like to do anymore.

Oh, I wish, that sounds like a lot of fun. I'm a little shy and only recently moved to town for school, so I'm not involved in any activities at the moment.

That sounds easy are they safe for human consumption?
They are safe for human consumption because it's all basic grocery items we use in our regular food. I'm not sure they would taste good to a human because there is no sugar in there
Well what else can you bake?
For humans, I can bake pies, cookies, quiches, cakes, anything. For pets, i can bake cookie treats.

dialog.text: I was talking with a friend an hour ago, and they told me their Great Dane is very calm and quiet. I think that would be a good dog breed to consider if you plan on getting one. Hopefully the shelter has one that you can adopt.
Those seem like nice dogs, however they are extremely large from what I understand.

I think it may be a problem because since I have retired, we have downsized into a condo. I don't think that would be fair to a big dog to confine them into a condo. I was looking at one called a Shetland Sheepdog. Do you know anything about that breed?

I don't really know much about Sheepdogs, no. I know they're gorgeous animals, though. I heard they're easy to train as well, but I have no experience with them. Is that the dog you're looking into getting? No other options?
That dog really appealed to me, but I am open to other options. Do you know of any small breeds that are not stubborn? My wife wants one that with snuggle on her lap.

I think all small dogs tend to be stubborn. I haven't really heard of any that aren't. They tend to be quite yappy and have a bigger attitude than their body. Haha. They all seem to be harder to train. Maybe if it was mixed breed with a less stubborn dog, then it would be easier? I'm not sure. German Shepherd are pretty well behaved dogs. They're not as big as Great Danes either.
I absolutely love German Shepherds but my wife already said no to that. I think we will have a hard time compromising on this one. Maybe we should just get a cat instead haha...kidding!

I don't have cat and never have. I would definitely probably want to get a cat if anything were to happen to my dog. I heard they're very low maintenance. Might be perfect since you're retired!! Haha.

Ok maybe that is a good point. But I don't know if I can really walk a cat. Part of the reason I wanted to get a dog was so that it would force me to get outside and walk every day. I have a step contest with my local retirees in the condo building.

I think you wouldn't have too terrible of a time walking a cat if you get it while it's younger. Just do it everyday and often and it should get used to the harness or collar you use. It'll be harder if they're older I assume.
Yes, I don't really see people walking cats in my neighborhood. I feel like my fellow veterans would laugh and make fun of me.

That sounds good to me. I'm not sure I want an older dog. Did it seem friendly?
It was super friendly. It was very social with the other dogs, as well. I think you will love it! It also wasn't too big, so it should fit your lifestyle pretty well. How is school going?

Yes, sometimes kids can be mean, but it always get better. You just need to find those kids that are like you, and get a good friend group going. Don't worry about the haters!
Thank you. I know you didn't like gym class either, but I don't know if you ever told me why.
I never felt like I was athletic enough to participate. It was kind of hard for me, because I always felt like I was behind. What is it about gym you don't like?
Same for me. I'm afraid of the balls flying in my face. I can't handle that, and no one ever wants me on their team. Also, I hate the outfit I have to wear. Did you have to wear a gym outfit?

Yes my parents are actually in favor of it.  It will be a therapy dog of sorts because of the trouble I am having at school.  They think it will improve my mood and reduce my general anxiety.

Yes, I know they do. But, I think getting a puppy to begin with would be a good start and then when I am more confident, I can rescue them from shelters.
Perhaps. Do you have much space to keep a large dog?
We have a really big garden. Also, I would be more than happy for it to stay in my room, not sure how much my mum would be happy with that though.
That's a good point. Sometimes they could bring fleas into the house, or even ticks! It's good if the dog can have its own bed at least.
Really? Are the transferable to humans? I would be scared if I got them
Well, fleas can bite you but I don't think they stay on you. Ticks are a bigger problem because they can carry Lyme disease. I have a friend who got that and she said it's pretty serious!
Oooo that sounds serious. I am sure if I was to get a dog from the rescue center, they would have made sure that they don't have fleas or ticks, right?

Oh definitely! But you have to protect them with special collars or some drops you put on their skin. Usually you have to use the drops once a month. I'm sure the shelter even sells the drops, but you could get them at any pet store. And don't forget to buy a good leash!
I have seen videos of people being pulled over by their dogs when they have them on leashes and the dogs want to run. I am scared that will happen to me and I will get hurt!

That's fantastic.  Is this for a private client or for a public space like a mural?
It is at a school. I can't wait to inspire them. Do you display any of your photographs anywhere?

A little of both, actually. It's a Smashing Pumpkins shirt, but it has also lasted a long time. They just don't seem to make clothes to last anymore. They fall apart so quickly now, unless you buy really expensive stuff.

Again, I think it is part of the business model. They make products to have a certain lifespan and therefore they need replacing, whereas years ago they were much more bothered about their reputation - companies, that is.
Totally. And fast fashion has just encouraged us to change styles constantly to keep up with the trends. I'm glad I'm not so young anymore, so I don't have to try so hard!

dialog.text: Do you think your daughter will want to follow in your shoes and be a doctor one day?

I'm not sure. I've thought about it, but it isn't something I want to push on her. She's under a lot of pressure as it is changing schools and moving. Really, right now all I want is her to be happy and focus in school and do well. As long as she is successful, I'll be happy with whatever she decides to do I think. But I wouldn't be mad if she decided to follow in my footsteps!
Good to keep your options open, and be receptive. Sometimes we have to listen better, and our kids will show us, tell us what they need. I admire you being a doctor
Thank you. I admire your work, too. We have both dedicated our lives to the helping of others. I think that you must find your work with children extremely rewarding, even if difficult at times.
It seems like a natural thing, although these days I'm trying to listen to the kids better. We have our pre conceived notions, and sometimes if they're happy being simple, let that be.
Once you get your life together, and get focused, I'm sure you'll be able to provide lots of help to other children that were in your position.
I hear you. The big thing is being seeing with equal respect, and asking questions, before making judgments. Judgments can shut me down sometimes, from others. We have to make amends too.

People will always have their judgements. I think it's best to try and not let it have any bearing on what you do and how you feel, and always just follow your heart. You're not a bad kid, you've just made some mistakes. I think you have the right attitude to really turn this thing around.
We will see. We are learning all kinds of things at school. We learn Speech and Debate, Writing, although listening skills, why they never teach that. Have you ever taken classes on that?

Of course! We have to take all kinds of classes before we can ever go to school for our Doctorates. I also took classes like speech and debate. But I think you prose a very important question about "listening skills", because listening is fundamentally so much more important.
Agreed. I follow and trust by example. Just have a couple rules to be my friend, maybe I'll tell you what they are some day.
Well, whatever those rules are, I'll be glad to be your friend and help you with anything I can!

dialog.text: So how is the weather in Nebraska - has it started to warm up yet? It doesn't get so cold down here in the south.

It's not very nice today, just 55 degrees, but this time of year it can change pretty rapidly. The weather forecast says it should be nicer on the weekend, so maybe I'll go out for a walk with my daughter.
Nice. I just wish I could go out for a walk at all. Just three more weeks and I'm out.
That's good to hear. Do you have any plans for what to do when you get out? I guess you must miss seeing your friends.
I really want to go out to the movies with my old friends. Some of them never visited or wrote me, though, so I don't know where we stand.

I think you should still contact them. If someone disowns you just for getting in trouble when you're young, they're not a very loyal friend. Lots of people get in trouble when they're young. And if they love films as much as you do, it could be a good way to reconnect with them.
I will get in touch, I'm just afraid they don't want to do anything with me anymore. Even though some of them shoplift just like I did, but didn't get caught.

Don't be scared. In life, sometimes people won't want to be your friend because they judge you, but that's fine, you wouldn't want to be friends with someone who would judge you negatively either. When things go wrong, that's when you find out who your friends really are. The important thing, no matter how old you get, is to use your experiences to improve yourself.
Good advice. How old is your daughter, by the way? Is that the kind of stuff you tell her?

She's 10. As a parent of course you try to give your kids good advice, but mostly they don't take it. As they say, 'a lesson merely heard is never a lesson learned!' Everyone needs to make their own mistakes and learn from them.
I agree, just hope the mistakes aren't too bad. Are you still trying to switch schools for her?

Yes, but it's not that easy because I'm also trying to change my job at the same time, so I have to do lots of things at the same time. I think she could get a better education at a different school but of course it's harder to get your kid into a good school.

dialog.text: I recently finished a new fantasy novel. It's quite interesting.
Oh, that's wonderful. What is it called, and whom is the author?
Well first, let's see if you'd like the themes. How do you feel about time travel, and rock bands?
I mean, I like the movie "Bill and Ted's Excellent Adventure". So my feelings are generally positive regarding this topic.
I like your sense of humor. It's kind of hard to explain, so thanks for your patience. It's about this rock band that uses music, to rip open dimensions, and time travel, saving people.
That sounds interesting enough. It has to be more interesting than what I am reading. I'm reading Sterne's "Tristram Shanty", and it's boring and pedantic to say the very least.
Tristram eh? Well, that reminds me of Tristan and Isolte, which I also probably misspelled, which is a classic old story. What's the Shanty book about?
The novel largely concerns itself with events and personages from before the author's birth. Some even might call it an, "anti-novel".
Does sound a bit dry. Actually the way you describe it, I'm not sure you really like the book, which tells me if I should read it also.
I don't always read for pleasure. Sometimes, I read purely to gain knowledge of a particular person, author, or subject. But yes, this one is rather dry!!!
I hear you there. Now I'm wondering what kind of books you do like, if there are any recent ones?
I wouldn't say it's new, but I've taken more time lately to read Philosophy. My last read was the "Bhagavad Gita", the famous Hindu text. I'm sure you've heard of it?

That's why I camp on the beach, much less bugs. Have you tried beach camping?>
No I haven't. It does sound nice, I'm just not sure where to do it actually. At the beaches near me, I'd be worried a cop would come and kick me out for staying the night

dialog.text: I looked in to rafting the grand canyon and sent you a link to a rafting company that does that.
That sounds really coo, I will have to check it out. How are the rapids? Are they pretty intense?
It depends on the time of year, but they can be intense in places. Do you think you will go with us on this trip? I know you've always wanted to raft the grand canyon.
I really want to. I think I can get work off. What kind of supplies do you bring for food?
You won't have to worry about any of that for this trip. I am going to get the food all taken care of with a friend of mine. He loves to cook and is going to do all of it for the trip.
Wow, that sounds great! What is the weather supposed to be like while we're there?
Right now it looks like there is no rain, mostly sunny with some cloudy days. We'll see how it pans out. You know how weather can be.
What was your favorite part when you did it last summer?
It rained a lot and the river was up at all time levels. The rafting was intense and I got soaked on more than one occasion. It was a blast for me in these hectic conditions.
What about the gear bags? Did you have any issues with water getting in?
Nope. We always use dry bags. There is no way for the water to get into them.
I guess that helps. How much gear am I limited to? I don't want to overfill the boat..

I've published a couple in my discipline, but nobody reads them except specialists. I'm actually thinking about writing a comprehensive manual to survival in the wilderness.

I would be willing to take care of as many as two rabbits temporarily.

I donate money to charity from my salary. I volunteer at a rabbit rescue. We have 30 or more rabbits to look after and rehome.I do adopt some of the rabbits myself.
I live in an apartment with a shared garden. I keep my rabbits in the garden. I would like to get started on container gardening.

I live in the same apartment complex as one of my coworkers.
I am trying to find permanent homes for my rabbits.

dialog.text: I harvested a bunch of cucumbers last week. I can drop some off for your rabbits if you like.
That would be great, the rabbits would really love the cucumbers. We try to give them fresh produce, but it can be expensive.
Have you decided yet if you needed me to take care of the rabbits for a little bit? I don't mind helping out.
I would love to let you have one if you think it will make a great pet, I am trying to find forever homes for them.
I understand... but you know what the doctors say. I wont be around much longer myself. But maybe it would be nice to have a little more company in the mean time.
Yeah, I know what you mean, I will consider your offer. What else do you garden besides cucumbers?

Well, just about a little of everything, I suppose. It really helps me to take my mind off of everything. We grow carrots, tomatoes, peppers, beans, lettuce, you name it! I probably got it. I was actually going to ask you if you had any kind of netting I could use to help protect my strawberries from the birds?
Yeah, I definitly have some extra netting laying around, when can I drop by to hand it off to you?

Honestly, I don't have the energy I used to have, and I don't feel comfortable leaving the house by myself. I really only go out to my garden these days. If you could bring it to my house, that would really help me out.
We can do that. Gardening is a lot of hard work, I understand why you don't have a lot of energy.
The gardening I can handle, but the cancer, I feel like it saps all the energy I have. Some days I can't even leave the bed. But I'm still here, and I'm happy just to see another day.
I'm glad that you have an outlook like that. It must be really tough for you. Keep on fighting, you will beat it!

the usual's. like tomatoes, peppers, cucumbers, green beans, lettuce, strawberries, blueberries.
Awesome, I wish I could grow things. I have an apartment, but maybe one day when I have my own house.

I know nothing about this, do you have nay good resources to get me started?

I will look into that, thanks. How is your health?

doctors said anywhere from 6 months to 1 year. so I'm just trying to live every day to the fullest right now.
That's all you can do I guess. I wish you all the happiness over your remaining days.

dialog.text: Have you looked into starting your container garden?
I have! Got some seedlings in my windowsill and keep moving them out when they're big enough. How's your garden?
It is going pretty good. I am hoping that the strawberries come in ok, I sometimes have birds getting after them.
We get a lot of birds in our garden too, do you get netting to protect your fruit?
I need to. I just need to get a frame built to put it over. Do you have any suggestions?
I just use some bamboo canes with netting attached for mine. You still feeling able to get out and do much or have you managed to talk the kids into helping?
Ha! They really don't want to help. They will eat the preserves and salsa I make, but don't want any part of the care and upkeep. How are the rabbits doing?
Haha, sounds like most kids. Still plenty to look after. People come to adopt them, but feels like two arrive for every one we rehome.
I guess they multiply like rabbits! Lol. Do you ever adopt any of them?
I do take some home. That's why I decided to do some container gardening. Easier to stop them from eating everything when they get out!
I bet that would be a hassle. Rabbits can be really cute, though. Maybe I'll come look at adopting one!
They are really cute! I'll bring some over sometime soon for you to spend some time with. They're quite therapeutic when they're on your lap.

dialog.text: How many rabbits do you have at home now?
We have about 30 Rabbits now and a few of them are pregnant so we are expecting more pretty soon!
That's so many rabbits! How do you guys have enough to feed them all?
Thankfully, the rabbit rescue has been getting a lot of donations recently meaning that we have a surplus and to stop it going to waste, the volunteers are allowed to take it home with them
Your apartment must be so big to be able to fit all those rabbits! I have a lot of produce from my gardens I could give you for your rabbits!
The apartment has a shared garden, and the other residents don't mind me having them in the garden, They love them. What type of produce do you have?

I started growing carrots! I also have some crunchy fresh cucumbers if rabbits eat those. I remember bumping into one of the residents the last time I visited! He said something about seeing rabbits in a shipyard container??

They LOVE carrots and cucumber. I am sure they would be grateful to be given some. So, thank you! Yeah, one of the residents works with me at the shipyard. and we found some rabbits in one of the containers when we were emptying them. I have no idea how they got there, but given my volunteering, I thought it was quite the coincidence.
I would love to feed them sometime soon! That's interesting haha for a second I thought you might have been breeding and shipping rabbits!!

Noooo, not shipping them, or breeding to be honest. I don't have the space for any more, even the babies that are due to come. I will need to see if some other people want to keep them. Would you be interested?
I would love to have a rabbit or two to care for! Unfortunately, I will not be able to take care of them for long!

Any relief would be great. It would give me some time to find some permanent homes for them. At the minute, it seems like not many people want rabbits, but I am sure I will be able to find some people to lighten the load for me

dialog.text: How was volunteering at the homeless shelter? Do you plan on learning any other instruments?

Maybe when the kids get bigger they can help out. Right now they volunteer at the pet shelter, but that is just because pets are not as sketchy as some people are. I want them to be old enough to know basic self defense before letting them work with adults.
That is a good idea!  There are some people out there for sure that would hurt a child.  What about you?  Do you do any volunteer work?

I help with the PTA and we do bake sales and food drives for the famililes in the school that need assistance and cannot get any. It isn't much, but last year we were able to help a single mother get new tires and a radiator with the funds we raised to help her be able to keep her job. It was a good feeling.
That is really impressive!  Every bit of help anyone can do for another counts.  Have you been playing your violin lately?
No, not today at least. I do like to play, but kids keep you busy. What about you?
No violin lately. I've been busy with piano lessons.  You'd be surprised just how many people out there are wanting to learn to play now!
Oh no, I do know. My daughter wants to learn it, but every time we pay for lessons, she goes for a few of them and then just stops.
Really?  Why is that?  Is it that she doesn't like the piano or she isn't connecting with the teacher?

We have tried 3 different instructors and she is always excited the first day and then by the third or fourth lesson she says it is impossible to learn, her hands are too small and she can't stand anything. It is heartbreaking.
Oh no!  You tell her that that is not true! Her hands are not too small! She can definitely learn how to play.  Why don't you let me give it a try and see if I can get her interested in playing?

Then sure, I am interested, that's basically free considering how expensive rower machines are. Thank you a lot! How are your cats by the way?

I bet they love that. Running outside is so much better, especially if you have fun companions. Have you tried to hike with them?
No, not yet... They don't really like going out, which is weird I guess haha. I'll try to take them with me when we go hiking next time, thanks!
That is strange, lol. Well maybe it's not for them. I wish I could take my cats out, but I think people would give me strange looks.
It doesn't matter what other people think, don't worry! Just take your cats out and see if they like it, in the end it is all that matters.

personas: I trained for the Olympics. I like to run.

dialog.text: How are you finding the rowing machine? Is it helping your exercise?

Yes, I'm quite happy with it.  It's in really good shape--better than I expected--and I like having it at home to use when the weather outside isn't conducive to running.  So thanks for facilitating the purchase for me with your friends!

I'm so glad you are liking it!  I remember when I was training for the olympics, I had to run outside no matter what the weather was.  It's great to have an indoor alternative!  I still like to run, but not when it's too hot outside!
Yes, I'm sure that for Olympic training there's no choice but to forge ahead, regardless of how you feel or what the weather's like.  Was 1992 the only Olympics you got to compete in?
Yes, I'm afraid so.  I ended up with an injury in 1993 and that pretty much ended my competitive career.  Now I like to coach other athletes such as yourself....
Do you currently coach anyone you think has a shot at winning a medal at the Olympics?
No, I just work with local athletes. I have to stay pretty close to home due to my cats, and especially now that one of my cats is ill. I'm really worried  about her.
Oh no!  Has it not gotten any better?  I think you better take her to the vet if she hasn't started to improve by now.
Yes, I've been thinking that. It's hard to take her out of the house but I guess I have to do it. Do you have a near by vet that you trust your dogs with?
Yes, actually I do.  One of my dogs ate a rock one time and had to go to the vet.  I really trust them even though I've only been once.  Would you like their name and phone number?
Wow that sounds scary!  Yes, please sendme the information if you get a chance. I'm sure if you trust the that they will be able to help me, hopefully without costing a fortune!

Yes, I don't remember them being costing too much.  Of course I was mostly just glad that my dog was okay.  I'll have to look for their information though.  I'll get it to you as soon as I find it.  Have your cat's symptoms been getting worse?

dialog.text: My cat that I was worried about because he was ill is getting worse.

Oh, I can relate to that. One of my dogs is older and has diabetes. Do you know when you'll be able to take them in to the vet?

Later today for sure. She went off her food yesterday morning and still isn't eating yet today. She's drinking water, though, so it might just be something transient. Still, I don't want to chance it.
That's very good that you'll be able to get them in today! I find its best not to wait, especially when they have chronic issues. Hopefully it's nothing serious!
Hopefully! We'll have to see. My vet's a good guy, does a complete assessment, so I'll know more later in the day.  She's a sweet animal and I'd had to lose her.
That's so great. It's so important to have a caring vet! I'll pray for your cat to get well soon! Why don't you tell me what the Olympics was like. Maybe that will get your mind off your worries.
It was such an exciting time for me, really gave me an opportunity to excel in my sport. The training over the year before was the most difficult thing I've ever done, but it was worth every second!

Daily, in the early morning and late afternoon, for two or more hours. Had to follow a strict exercise and dietary regimen in addition to the sprint training. Socializing was rare, because I was exhausted half the time, and my coach wanted me in bed at a decent hour.

dialog.text: What has been one of the most surprising things you've experienced since coming to America?

I have enjoyed the simple things like going to the grocery store and being able to see all the fresh fruits and vegetables in perfect rows. I also like being able to go to church and be free to take a bible everywhere I go.
It really is the little things, I understand that. You were not able to do those things in Somalia?
I wasn't allowed to go anywhere without my abusive husband. He never went to church and he didn't believe in God or anything like that. He mostly made me clean and stay home to cook.
I am so sorry to hear you went through that. I am glad you are safe now and free to be yourself. Do you have any dreams or goals you are working towards now that you are living in the US?
Thank you, I appreciate your kind words. I would like to study and get some sort of degree. I really like helping others so I need to find a job that is serving others. I am open to ideas.
That is a great quality to have. Maybe you could look into social work or nursing?
Hey, thats what I was thinking about too. I used to help people who would get hurt and I would bandage up the local kids wounds. I want to look into nursing. Do you ever miss your country?

That is a great idea to get into something you are passionate about. I do miss India sometimes, but I have a lot of family and friends who also moved to America, so spending time with them is like being back home.

That is nice and comforting for you. I noticed that when I spend time with my aunt I also feel a sense of home and become less homesick for my country. I don't want to go back there but also get sad and miss it sometimes, it's confusing.

Do you want to try my spicy variety?

dialog.text: How is your garden coming along?
It's coming along fine!  Everything is growing right on schedule.  All of this rain we have been getting lately has been great for it and it keeps me from having to spend time watering!
That is really great! What kind of plants are you growing?

I am growing tomatoes, yellow squash, okra, and bell peppers.  With summer fast approaching having some fresh vegetables around will make meals light and easy!  Hey, I can fed ex you some if you want when they are ready.
That would be great, are you sure it wouldn't cost too much? Do you preserve any of your vegetables?

No, don't worry about cost. I'll be glad to do it!  I do make salsa and jar it.  I get some cilantro, jalepeno, and onions from a neighbor in trade for some of my okray and squash.  Do you want me to send you a couple of jars?

He's fitting in and learning the ropes perfectly!  You know, he's really going to be a big help around here.  Have you gotten a cat yet?
I am still looking. I have been checking out the local shelters to see if there's a rescue I can adopt.
Wonderful idea!  There's always a ton of cats and kittens at the shelters.  Are you looking for something specific?
No, just one that seems to fit me. I think that if I see the one, I'll know. I just need to get out and start looking. Have you been able to train your dog?
I'm working on it.  The main thing is to get him used to the cows and know how to handle them if necessary.

dialog.text: I researched some job openings in Washington to see what area might be good to move to.
What kind of work are you looking for?

I think I want to continue my work as a life coach. But I think I think it would be too hard to move somewhere and try to start a new business at the same time. Ideally, if I could find a way to keep traveling, and continuing to life coach around the country, I would.
That makes sense. Finding new clients might be hard. Could you keep working with your current ones?

I could. I have started doing online seminars a couple times a week for people who can't make it in person, and people have really been responsive so far. It also gives me time to talk to people about different approaches on holistic medicines, meditation practices, etc.
Do you do a lot of work with oils? I am loving the new lemon essential oil I received from my order.

Yes, actually. I have tried the lemon as well, and I really liked it. I was not a big fan of peppermint. I would definitely be willing to try more. If they are effective, maybe they are something I could share with my classes.
What was it about peppermint that you don't like? What other holistic medicine do you use?

I think it was just too strong for me. It made it too hard for me to focus and meditate. I have experimented a lot with aromatherapy, as well as massage therapy. I've found both to be extremely beneficial for me as well as some others.
Not to change the subject but where did you live before New Mexico.
I've lived all over, really. But before I lived in New Mexico, I was living in Denver, Colorado. That's when I first discovered I had cancer and went into treatment.
Cancer has changed both of our lives that much can be said for it.

personas: I may apply for a new job.
I may apply to be a backstage manager at a local theatre.
I am currently a veterinarian.
I play role playing games.
I like plays. Randomness intrigues me.
I may apply for a ticket taker position. I currently clean houses.

dialog.text: I recently found a new job I may apply for. It would give me more freedom than my current one.
That's great! What's the job?
It's at a local theatre.  I'll be doing backstage management.
What is that work like?
It's a lot less stressful than being a veterinarian.  I will basically be running props, sets and how the players leave and enter the performing area.
What sorts of plays does the theatre put on? Do you ever have stirring renditions of Shakespeare plays?
Mostly, the place does Indie work.   The guy who runs the place also plays role playing games, so he like organically crafted stories.
I would be interested to see a play where the scenes are selected by a role of the dice.
That would make for an interesting show, for sure.  It would rely on a lot of improv.   I'll bring it up the next time we have an RPG night.
Yes, certainly it would be. Congratulations, it sounds like it will be a lot of fun as a job.  Certainly less stressful than medical care.
You should check it out.   Their ticket taker just moved to Oregon, so there's an open job available.
I'll look into it, I'd prefer it to cleaning houses.  What are the hours like?

personas: I used to work as a veterinarian.
I have anxiety. I am looking for a new job. Talking to people makes me nervous. My last job traumatized me.
I applied for a job at a theater. I don't like blood.
I'm not making any money right now. I need money.
I've invested in crypto-currency. I've invested in stocks. I have money in a savings account.
I'm going to retire in a few years. I'm using a new cleaning product. I'm allergic to this new product.

dialog.text: I quit my job after seeing an abused dog, it was bloody, I can not handle it anymore.
Oh,,,, I am so sorry you had to experience that! Will you see a therapist to talk about this trauma?
Uh nah. I don't like to talk to people like that. It makes me nervous. My anxiety is too bad to talk to someone. But I am looking for another job now.
Did you apply to that theater job you mentioned?
I did. I haven't heard anything back. I am not sure they are even hiring right now, but I am looking around for something less bloody.
I can understand the eww factor of blood! Do you have any other leads for jobs?
I filled out applications at a local gas station, a grocery, and I went to a local employment agency to see if they can find me something. I need a job.
This might be a substantial pay cut from being a Vet. Are you prepared for that?

I mean, I quit my job completely. I took a 100 percent pay cut. The employment agency can get me ok paying jobs if they find one, but even being a grocery stocker would be better than making zero dollars right now.
You are so right! I don't know what I was thinking when I asked that. You have a whole new path in front of you, a new chapter in your life.

Yeah and it is kind of scary. But it helps that I have bought into crypto and stocks over the last few years. If I run out of savings, I can pull some from that. How is everything going with you? Have you decided to retire?
I dream of retiring but that's not for a few years yet. I am doing good but my hands are reacting to a new cleaning product that I am using. I need to go out and get some better gloves.

personas: I'm looking at getting a new job. I work at home as a vet and I am getting sick of it.
I am working with an employment agency. I applied as the backstage manager at a theater. I need a change of pace.
I decided to not apply for a ticket taker job. I am thinking of finding a job where I would work online.
I'd like to do some online work where I take surveys or type things out. I am not a fast typer. Typing would be less strenuous than cleaning.
I want to look into crypto but I need to be thinking about retirement.
I don't think I am suited for theater work. I think I would need to make more money than that.

dialog.text: Did you apply for the ticket taker job? How are your hands healing?
Thanks for asking! They're okay now, but I decided not to apply for the position. I'm thinking about trying to do some work online instead.
That sounds like it might be a better option. What kind of work would you do online?

I heard about how you can do things like online surveys or typing things out. I'm not a fast typer but it's less strenuous than cleaning, that's for sure. Do you think it's a good idea for somebody like me?
I don't know much about it but it sounds like it might be less stressful than cleaning. Maybe do some looking around online to see what you can find out.
Maybe if I do it, I'll ask your advice about investing in crypto like you mentioned. I worry it's just a fad, and I'm not getting any younger, so I need to be thinking about retirement savings.
Yeah, none of us are getting any younger! I'm looking to get a new job myself. I'm sick of working at home as a vet.
Has the employment agency given you any more interesting options? Seems like with your experience people would be happy to hire you. Working with animals requires a lot of patience and care.
Yeah, I don't want to do this kind of work anymore though. I've applied for a backstage manager at a theater. It would be a nice change of pace if I can get the job.

Plus it would be free entertainment, right? Maybe I should try something like that. I don't think I'm suited to theater work, and I think I need to make more money than that. But since you've got savings you should definitely go for it!
That's what I was thinking, unless of course I'm not allowed to watch anything. Who knows how it will be until I get in there and give it a try!
Oh that's a good point. I suppose if you're backstage you don't see much. But you'll be there for rehearsals, right? So you might end up hating the repetition!
