personas: I have been pregnant. I'm going to have my 5th set of twins in two months. My family helps to take care of the children. I love being pregnant. I do not have names picked out for the babies I am pregnant with.
I just bought my first home. I previously lived in a two bedroom apartment. I'm excited that the new home has more room for everyone.
I work at the bank. I'm busy.
I have not had soda in a long time. I can't eat the same thing twice in two weeks. I enjoy homemade burgers. I eat cookies and other snacks.
I am married.
I just moved into a house and I live with my boyfriend Tim.
I enjoy walks around my neighborhood.
I eat a lot of hamburgers and french fries. I don't like and never drink soda.

The home we moved into is previously owned. Much of the house was built in the 1920s but changes were made to it over the years. We would like to do some reno on the home. One room with glass wall tiles reminds me of a lounge at a Holiday Inn, so we're redoing it. We have a grill in the backyard. I am remodeling the bathroom of my new house. I will be putting plants and fun colored lights in my bathroom.
I'm fickle with burger toppings. Sometimes I like salad on top of the patty, sometimes plain ketchup.
I mostly take care of just myself. I don't have family or friends nearby.

dialog.text: What is your next remodel project on the house, after you finish the bathroom?
I want to try and redo the room with the glass wall tiles next. I'll be working for a while! How is the preparation for your babies coming along?
Good. Luckily, I have a lot of family helping me. Being pregnant with twins makes moving around a little bit difficult but I'm managing.
Make sure to keep resting! I am curious - how are you so lucky to keep having sets of twins? What does your husband think?

Oh, I will for sure. I've done this a few times already, so I'm practiced in the art of relaxing! Ha! Both my husband and I come from families of twins, so I guess we're just genetically primed for it. My husband loves having a large family, which is handy since we have so many kids!
I suppose that definitely works out for you! Do you have any pregnancy cravings at the moment?
Nothing too crazy. I just crave more of the stuff I liked before, like homemade burgers and snacks. With so many kids, it's easy to have snacks about. How about you? Any plans for kids?
I think one day I would like to have kids, but definitely not yet. I would like to live closer to my family before I decide so they are around to help and support me!

Yeah, family support is critical. You really get to know your family when you have kids. Some are helpful and some aren't. You'll get so much advice ... some of it useful and some not. I'll try not to give you too much, but you're welcome to all my baby stuff when you're ready.
Oh, that would be absolutely wonderful, thank you very much! I wish you all the best for your labour. I am very curious on how many bedrooms you have with so many twins!

Labor will be a breeze, I think. I'll still go to the hospital just to be safe, but at this point I'm a regular there! I've been there so many times that they should give me my own parking spot! Ha! Our house has 6 bedrooms. It's a lot, but after the small place we had before, it's nice to have each set of twins have their own room.

Oh wow! How many bedrooms were in your last house? Definitely better to be safe than sorry I think! Hopefully it goes by without a hitch! Would save on the parking payments too if they gave you a spot!

dialog.text: My agent told me I can move to my new home asap.
That's great news!  I'm really excited for ya.
Thanks so much! I'm really excited to have more room for everyone. How are you liking the new house?
Well, I just moved in, with my boyfriend, Tim.  I like it.  It all feels so new.
Did you guys get a new construction or previously owned?
Previously owned.  The core of the place was built in the 20's but then updated in the 50's.  The last restoration was like 86 or 87.
Wow so the home is almost 100 years old, that's pretty cool! Do you see yourself doing any reno soon?

Some, but not a lot.  One room has those little glass wall tiles.  It reminds me of a lounge at a Holiday Inn.  So that room is going to get redone.   Other than that, the place is great.   We grilled burgers out back, lastnight.
Sounds good. Do you add lot of variety to your burgers or do you like them plain and simple?
I hate to say this, but I'm fickle.  Sometimes, I pretty much put a salad on top of the patty.  Sometimes, just plain ketchup.  It just depends.
Nothing wrong with that. I can never eat the same thing twice in two weeks so I guess I beat you in that category lol
I feel ya.  With having so many sets of twins, you pretty much need some variety.

dialog.text: I've been craving a burger since you mentioned them earlier, so I might have one soon.
Do you prefer to make the burgers yourself or pick them up from a restaurant?
Nothing beats a homemade burger but being so pregnant and taking care of all these kids, I don't think I have the energy.
I don't know how you can handle so many kids. I struggle just taking care of myself some days, let alone worrying about so many little ones.

Yes, it can be very exhausting, but I wouldn't change it for the world. And the benefit of having all twins is that each kid has a built-in best friend to play with, so they can occupy each other after a certain age.
I never thought of it that way. Do you ever worry that they will gang up on you? One distracts you will the other sneaks into the kitchen to steal the cookies...

Oh, they are already pulling those tricks! Luckily I have a lot of family to help, it takes a village, as they say! Sometimes I have to lock myself in the bathroom to eat my snacks to get a moment of peace, and not have them all want to eat all my cookies!~
That's great that you have so much help. My family doesn't live close, so I'd be on my own if I ever have kids. By the way, how are you enjoying the new house?

Do you have any friends in the area? Oh the new house it amazing! We really needed that extra space, the kids are loving having more personal space. They still have to share bedrooms, but only with their other twin,
No friends I'd trust to watch my kids. I'm glad you're enjoying the house. You deserve it.
Thanks, that means so much! Well when the time comes for you to have kids, I will happily take on the role as a babysitter; what's one or two more kids to throw in the mix? haha!
Lol. Thanks. I will definetly have many questions (if we decide to have kids).

So unique! I love it! I will run it by my husband.

Time well spent, for sure! Enjoy!!
Have a wonderful day and take care!

personas: I have two jobs. I am a stunt double and love it. I get to meet famous people.

I've been hired to be Brad Pitt's stunt double. My audition was nerve-wracking. My audition for the movie consisted of jumping through a stack of three window panes. I had no injuries during my audition. I went through the window panes in hoops while riding a motorcycle.
I realized I wanted to be a stunt double in college after party mishaps. I enjoyed the parties in college.
I love "Cat Fancy" magazine. I read a lot.
I just got an audition.
I am not really interested in regular acting. I have met Hugh Jackman. I was a stunt double in The Greatest Showman. I recommend watching The Greatest Showman.
I don't have a job. I am thinking of going to college. I haven't been to college.
I am always on a diet. I love food. I want to look my best. I exercise.
I have a sister.
I considered school boring. I don't like to read.  I like parties. I prefer writing over reading.
I think working as a stunk double would be grueling.
I haven't seen The Greatest Showman. I have seen Wolverine and Les MIserables. I like songs from The Greatest Showman.

dialog.text: Have you ever considered cosmetology school? I know you like taking care of your looks and find regular school boring, so maybe cosmetology school would be interesting to you!
Cosmetology school would be fun.  That's where I learn to put makeup on people?

Yeah! Honestly, sometimes learning a trade can be the best route, especially if you are unsure on what you want to go to college for. Could be a great place to start, earn some good money, and establish yourself a little in the workforce and find out what your bigger goals are.
Where can I even apply that job at?  Movies?  Theaters?  Street corner?

Well, most cosmetologists have to go for schooling, first. But the schooling generally only takes a year or two. Once you've completed schooling, you usually already have a foot in the door working at a job in a salon somewhere either cutting hair, dying hair, doing make-up or other cosmetic procedures.
Oh, I think I could do that.  Do you know any cosmetologists I can talk to?

No, I'm not familiar with anyone personally. But there is a school called Paul Mitchell, named after a world famous cosmetologist. Maybe you could look up their website and browse around? That would be a great place to start and get some information, I think.
Thanks, I'll go take a look at their website.  Will I get paid a lot to do that?

I don't think I can answer that question. I think a lot of it depends on what training you receive, what specific job you take, what specific salon you work at, and how skilled you are. I think what you earn would be totally up to you! If you liked it enough, you could even consider opening your own salon.
Nice, I would love to own my own business.  I'm going to go to my nearest salon and interrogate the employees about what they recommend.
Well, maybe go in for a service, first! And just strike up a natural conversation while having your hair done or something. Wouldn't want to be intrusive, now!
Yeah, I'll try not to be too creepy about it haha.  Maybe I'll bring one of them to dinner to talk about it.

Wow! Sounds like they weren't doing much reading then, haha what a thing to use the library for!
Well I want to meet a smart man! Where else am I going to find one if not the library? Plus I figure just being near books will make me want to read more. It's better company than I usually keep.

I love that mag! and I'm not surprised. That sounds pretty common unfortunately.
I was more annoyed that someone was as clever as me and had the idea to steal it. Oh I should track down who stole it! Maybe they are my soul mate!
That would be a great love story! haha
You know what! That would make a great movie! I know I don't read much but maybe I can write a screen play and you can audition for it! I foresee many stunts in this romantic action movie!

I own some horses. I just bought a new stalion called Macho.
I own three horses and a donkey. I find horses great for de-stressing.
I farm bees with my wife.

dialog.text: What is it like not being close to family? I do want to move to a big city but my family will not be close by anymore.
It actually feels great! I know some families can be overwhelming but we are so happy to be able to see everyone whenever I want. Is there a big city close by? Maybe you don't have to move too far.
I guess I'm just anxious because it's not an easy decision to undo, you know? But if I want to be a lawyer I'll be so busy I don't have a bunch of spare time to see them anyway!
That's true! You have to think about your future.  How far are you going to be?
Not very far - a few hours - but I guess any distance at all seems like a big one to me!
Yeah, I can see that. But as long as you can still drive to see them, I think you will be fine. When are you starting school?
In September, if all goes to plan. But enough about me. How are the horses?
They are great! I love spending time in a barn. We recently purchased a new stalion. His name is Macho.
That's a great name for a horse! How many do you have altogether now?
Right now we have 3 horses and a donkey.  You would love them.  You need to visit sometimes.  Being around horses is so destressing.
I love donkeys! I do need to visit sometime, that's for sure.
We started farming bees too. That was my wife's idea.  I wasn't a fan at first but then it grew on me.

personas: I am going to school in September.
I am going to law school. I will be in New York City for school.
I am receiving a stipend for school. I don't mind eating cheap food.
I am married. My wife is a supermodel.
I live in the country. I am suspicious my wife is cheating.
I just bought a stallion. I once hired a PI.
I grow vegetables on my farm. I harvest honey on my farm.

dialog.text: I sent my acceptance letter to the school, so it's all official now - roll on September!
That's awesome! What city will you be moving to?
I'm going to Law School in New York City. Have you been?
I haven't been personally but my wife, the supermodel, goes down all the time for shoots.
How does your wife the supermodel enjoy living in the country?
She says she likes it but I am not so sure. She seems distant. I can't explain it. I might have her tailed next time she takes one of her extended trips.
How much does a PI cost these days? It's got to be less than the pony you just bought, right?

First off he is not a pony he is a stallion. PIs are about the same as they were five years ago when I last hired one for a different issue. They are more expensive in NYC in general, but that's like anything in the city. Have you budgeted that into your move to the city for college?
My apologies to you and Macho the stallion. I'll be getting a stipend, if that's not enough, luckily, I like instant noodles.
You should try to eat right! I will bring you vegetables and honey from my farm, so you have something fresh and good to eat.
I'll tail your wife in exchange of veggies and honey
Well I was thinking maybe I could stay on your sofa a few nights so I can do it myself...

personas: I am looking for an apartment in New York.
I am in law school. I am looking for roommates.
I have a car.  My parents are married.
I am on a tight budget.
I have 4 horses.  I have a stallion.  I am married.
I have a donkey.

dialog.text: I just started looking for apartments in NY. Yikes!
Yes, I hear it is very expensive there.  You'll probably want someplace near the Law school too.
Yeah it is very expensive. Im trying to connect with a few other law students to see if we can all get somewhere together to make it easier finically.
That would be a good idea.  Have you had any luck yet? any prospects?
Yeah there is so far two that are interested so i'm trying to look for something that we can all fit in. How is your new stallion, is he getting on with the other 3 horses you have?
Yes, although he can be a bit temperamental at times.  He really likes my wife though.
Oh he probably just needs some more time. Stallions have a crazier temperament than females horses. But at least he has taken a liking to your wife.
Yes, whenever he sees the donkey following her he tries to chase it away. I think he's jealous!  Are you going to take your car to the city?  That can probably get expensive too, I imagine.
Yeah that mostly is a case of jealously especially if your donkey is male also. And no im going to leave my car at my parents the city is too busy easier to catch the train everywhere.
That makes sense.  Keeps you from having to find a nearby parking garage and having to put up with that expense as well.

Exactly i do not want to deal with that on top of everything else. I am hoping to also get something close to the school that way i don't ever really have to travel far. I will be too busy with school work for any leisure anyway.
You will have to find ways to unwind from school though eventually or you'll go bonkers!  I don't think I could adjust to living in the city.

You definitely don't want a breed that could get aggressive or that requires a considerable amount of training.  I find that golden retrievers, labs, and boxers are excellent companions.  I guess the other thing to think about is the size of the dog...would you want a smaller or more medium/large breed?
I would want one to keep in the house so it doesn't need to shed much.  I like the idea of a smaller dog but somewhat manly?  Andy idea of dogs based on that?

I personally have not, but my grandmother did.  She let the poor thing get drastically overweight.  The beagle did howl quite a bit, which was a bit much to deal with at times...but she also didn't train him to not howl as much, so maybe that could be something you work on with the dog.

Lucky for me, I work close to home, so I usually stop home for lunch, let the dogs out a bit to play and stretch, and then they go back in the crates until I'm done with work for the day.  Some people I know send their dogs to a doggie daycare.

Hey, good for you! Me? Well, I love my cats. All five of them, lol.
I want to see my cat! At least my moms is visiting soon. Have you been arrested?
Arrested?!? You think so... Lol. No, they have not caught me yet.
I am in here for shoplifting, with a month to go. What have you got away with?
My dad taught me a lot. Even how to stay out of jail, fortunately! Lol..
I wish I knew my dad. Do you have any tips for staying out of trouble?
Sure. Don't do drugs. Don't be stupid. Get married and obey your wife. Simple.
Sounds kind of boring! What do you do for fun?
Lol. I play with my cats. What could be funner?!?
I was caught stealing a new toy for my cat, so that doesn't help. P
Haha. You do not need to steal a toy. Cats can play with string, right?
Mine is spoiled, only wants the best! Do you have kids?
No kids. I work construction and can't afford them. Plus no girls love me.
No I feel like I am older then you! Want any tips on getting girls?
Yes please! Working construction, I whistle at lots of girls, but no luck.

dialog.text: So, a tip that might help you to get girls is to try to talk to them instead of whistling at them. For most girls, a guy whistling at them is very off putting.
I see.. I definitely won't whistle at them. How is your cat doing?
My cat is doing well! Thank you for asking. Hopefully approaching girls in calmer manner will help with your luck
I think it will. I'm going to try some of those dating apps to see if that will help. When is your mom coming to visit?
Dating apps may work out great. A great way to get to know someone. My mom is coming next week.
That sounds like fun. Does she have to go through any special protocols to get into the prison?
I will not be in prison when she visits. What type of girl are you looking for?
Someone down to earth, who doesn't mind camping and roughing it.
I am sure you can find her! And of course someone who likes your cats, right?
Of course! If she was allergic to cats, that would be a non-starter.
Do you want someone who wants to get married? Or have kids?
Maybe, but not yet. I'd rather enjoy the world and travel a bit before I settle down. What about you?

need some cat toys? ill be happy to send you some - dont steal

my cats are great thankx, ive never been in life without! they sleep 22 hours a day and keep me up at night when i need to sleep
That's not fun. I value my sleep way to much... lol. So, I forgot what you have 5 cats right? What are their names again?
yes five now, but always 3 at and given time
I absolutely love playing with my cats. We should get together sometime and have all our cats together. That would be too funny!
mine are not social, your are?

You should go for it! There's a good book you could read, called Calling in The One. And you could also try looking up how to write a dating profile that stands out on google. Have you used any of the apps before?

Something like match.com or Bumble. Those are the most serious dating sites.

I have a friend who is selling a classic Ford.

When I have free time I like to ride trails at the park. I have a few friends that like to go mountain biking and they go with me often. I am a part of a cycling club that meets and rides together once a week. I would be too scared to be too far out in the wilderness alone.

I ride my mountain bike on hiking trails. I like to check out difficult trails in the wilderness. I prefer to go mountain biking alone, but I have done it with a group before. I prefer to be out in the wilderness alone. I only keep my cell phone with me when i'm out in the wilderness alone.
I have been spending too much money on gas for my truck.

dialog.text: Have you been on any solo trips in the wilderness since I last saw you?
No I haven't had the time. I've been so busy lately. What kind of watches do you like?
Rolex, Timex, Swatch old school watches.  Timex takes a licking and keeps on ticking.  LOL!
Hey, I've heard that before. Funny! I have a friend who collects Swatch watches. She has tons of them.

Yeah, Swatch watches are colorful and fun.  Sometimes I feel like I should buy a long khaki trench coat and line the interior with watches and try to sell them to my customers that way.  I'm sure it will spark a laugh.
That is a cool idea! Certainly a fantastic way to shop. So what kind of bike to you have?

I have a Cyclamatic.  It's super cool.  Santa Claus helped me buy half of the price and I paid the other half.  I will ride down the street and laugh like Pee Wee Herman.  I do an excellent impersonation.
It sounds cool and you sound like a fun person! I just have a regular no name mountain bike but it does me well.

That's all that matters when it comes to bicycles.  Thank you,  I am a fun person most of the time.  Life is too short not to have fun.  Guess what song is running through my head?  Queens song "Bicycle."
Ha, ha! Love it! And you are right, life is too short not to have fun. I love spending time with family and friends just for that reason.

Indeed, I too spend alot of time with my family and friends.  It would be nice if we could get together in the near future.  Don't you agree?  We'll go riding and I'll try to do some bike tricks (without getting hurt, of course.)
Yes, I was thinking the same thing. We could stop at Starbucks and get a treat or two.

I should have been a barista... My dad makes fun of my career choice all the time.
Do you sell watches?
I do. But I spend all my paychecks on more watches. And shoes.

I subside entirely on royal crown cola.
That is funny. My favorite drink is a cup of coffee
If I collect enough empty cans I can sell them for a rolls royce.
That would be a lot of cans.
It isn't like I have it any other way, I'm paid entirely in broken watches.

dialog.text: Have you been mountain biking anywhere interesting lately?
Yes, actually. I went to a nearby trail and spent a few hours biking! It was so much fun! What is your favorite pair of shoe you own?

I have two brands of shoes that I tend to prefer. Jack Wolfskin and Oboz for their trail running shoes. They're a cross between a hiking boot and a running shoe. Super comfortable, waterproof, and durable.
Wow, interesting. I'll definitely have to check those out! Have you thought about getting a car so you don't have to bike to work or do you enjoy riding?
I have thought about it but I'm not sure it would pay off with savings in the end. I like vintage cars a lot. Do you mean vintage or modern cars?

I didn't have a specific type in mind. Wow, I really enjoy vintage cars too...preferably Chevy Trucks, like the 51' Apache or the 71' Chevy C10 Sidestep! Those are beautiful pieces of American made trucks!

I want a classic Ford, myself. I tend to be a Ford person, not a Chevy one. Either a '57-67 old truck, or a '67 Ford Mustang GT. I prefer cars that I can fix, today's are too computerized. I'm not sure buying one would pay off with work 2 blocks away.

You're so right about that, they make things to wear out faster and price things to high these days. I can see why now riding your bike is much more efficient! How convenient to be that close to you job! Guess what I did today? I went and tried out one of Starbucks Cinnamon Roll Frappuccino...it was fantastic! But I think their White Iced Mocha Frappuccino is my favorite!

That sounds fantastic! I love Starbucks but don't get it very often because it can be expensive. I love their Frappuccino's the most. I'll have to try the Cinnamon Roll one! I wonder if they have it at the shop near my home. Do you have other things you like there?

Oh yes, I love just about everything including their food selections. They have fantastic breakfast, they have a bacon gouda and egg sandwich that is just melts in your mouth! I tend to go to Starbucks to treat myself once every couple weeks. You're right it can be expensive. I am a nifty shopper and try to find coupons or discounts online before going. I meant to ask you, what kind of watches do you sell?

I usually buy gift cards when they're having bonus ones during the holiday season. Sometimes you can get $240 worth of gift cards there for $200 and such. I'm not as huge of a fan of their food, but I love trying all their drinks. I think the Refreshers are my favorite thing, along with the Cold Brew and the Frappuccinos. The new Kiwifruit/Starfruit Refresher is my new favorite. The Mango/Dragonfruit is a second.

I have seen the Mango/Dragonfruit but I haven't tried it. I have however, had the Kiwifruit/Starfruit Refresher it was pretty delicious! When Summertime comes I'll be interested in trying out the different refreshers.  I get in on those deals too, with the gift cards! I love free money!  I like gifting to friends and family too, they get excited when I share my good fortunes with them!

dialog.text: Do you go mountain biking on your own or do you go in a group?
I usually go alone, but I've done it with a group before too.  There's pros and cons to both.  How about you? Do you typically ride the trails along?
It depends on the day, I have a few friends that like to ride so they go with me quite a bit. I am also part of a cycling club and we all ride together once a week.
Yeah that sounds a lot like me.  I like being part of a community, but there's also something very freeing about being out in the wilderness all alone.
Do you wear any type of device that allows people to track your location for safety? I'd be scared being too far out in the wilderness all alone

I'll typically have my cell phone with me, but otherwise I don't do anything special.  You'd be surprised how well your body will keep track of things like your heading and the distance you've traveled once you've practiced a little bit.
I will take your word for it! Have you tried any new drinks at Starbucks lately?
Yeah I tried the Iced Pineapple Matcha last week and it was amazing!  Still haven't gotten to try the Kiwi Starfruit Refresher, but maybe next time!  Have you ever tried the pineapple macha?
I haven't, it sounds really interesting. I will add it to my list of drinks to try! The Kiwi Starfruit Refresher is still my favorite, you won't be disappointed.
I'll be sure to try it soon!  It's been so hot out lately that it sounds delicious right now actually.  Have you still been biking to work?
Yes, I have to take advantage of the nicer weather since I can't ride my bike to work in the winter. It helps me to feel like I've accomplished something first thing in the morning.
It must save you some money too! I feel like I've been paying an arm and a leg to gas up my truck lately.

dialog.text: Have you spoken to your brother about Rico? I really think you should get someone older involved. Him destroying your camera is a serious thing!
Yes I have, he said he will protect me. Do you think he will?
I sure hope he does. I am certainly concerned about the situation.
Do you plan to write book about bullying?
Yes, I was thinking of making a children's book about the danger of bullying. Do you think it will sell?
I think it would, especially if you include international settings. Have you ever been to Spain. I liek someone named Theda and they are from Spain
I have been to Spain! I have gone a few times and have fallen in love with the culture, its quite amazing. Will you ever go?

Could you inform me on how long the training lasts, and what it takes to join the institution.
The training for EMT's is no more than two semesters long.  You'll have to pass the EMT test.  I'm sure you'll do just fine.  How are things at the theatre? Have you seen any good movies lately?

Interesting, the Blacklist sounds like a list that someone shouldn't be on.  Is it a scary show?

Haha.. You have the idea. It is about some criminal concierge who has been granted immunity by the FBI, and who is their Confidential Informant, giving them valuable information about other criminals who are a threat to national security. Be as detailed as you can be about your interest(s) in the field. They want dedicated people, because the work is difficult and stressful on the body and mind.

Ah, no, that's not an issue. They want live, dedicated individuals...

The good folks who hire EMTs want people who are deeply interested in the work and who will be trainable and sustainable. You'll know pretty quickly whether or not you're cut out for the work. So don't worry about it. Apply and follow through. That's my professional advice.
Sounds good, maybe if you get this job at the clinic I'll be able to find work their too.  It would be awesome to know someone at work before as I'm getting started.

dialog.text: How are the horses doing?
My favorite horse, Jericho, unexpected died two days ago. I'm pretty broken up about it.
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that. Please let me know if there's anything I can do. Do you know what happened?
The necropsy showed that Jericho ate some toxic stuff. Can you distract me by regaling some funny stories from your volunteering?
I wish. It's been nothing but depressing stories at the shelter lately. I still love what I do, but times are really hard for everyone. Again, I'm so sorry about Jericho.
I'm sure he's enjoying his big open pasture in the sky. I'm sorry the shelter has been just depressing lately. Can I ask why you decided to volunteer with the homeless?

My father was actually homeless for a short amount of time, and it really stuck with me when he told me all about it. Just how ignored and invisible he felt, and so I wanted to make sure no one else felt that way.
Oh wow, what a personal connection. It must be tough and emotional. You are doing good work. How long have you been volunteering?
A few years now. It's definitely been a rollercoaster of emotions but I'd recommend it to anyone! Have you been to the kid's hospital lately?
I'm actually going later today. Those kids love ponies. It'll be a good distraction for me.
That's a good idea. Jericho will be watching down happily wherever he is. Did you ever take him with you?
No, I didn't take him to the hospital just the mini pony, Tina. I'm happy I won't have that association. Jericho actually hated kids. Have you been horseback riding?

I'm pretty sure she's with her boyfriend somewhere. They left last weekend to go to a Nascar race.
What of her boyfriend? Have you contacted or tried to contact him?
I don't know how to get in tough with him. I don't even know his real name. His friends just call him Killer.

Sometimes waiting can be detrimental. However, this would be your decision to make.
What would you do if you were me? Would you call the police today?

I've always dreamed to live in New York City and so I've applied for some jobs in NY. There were a few times I got an offer from some restaurants, but my sister still worries me. That's why I didn't accept the offers. Because I don't feel comfortable leaving her here. Is your sister employed?

That sounds good. What about playing basketball? I think now that you've passed your exams you have more free time to play. Is there a court near where you live?

Yep I was planning to go to the YMCA to play some pickup later tonight since I'm going to take the night off.  It's going to be so much fun to have more time to play.  I'm also looking forward to seeing a Knicks game when we're in NYC.

I'm so happy for you. I think you will have more time to play after you get employed and get established in your new job. I've been also interested in Knicks for years. Before worrying for my sister's situation fills my everyday life.
Your sister's baby is coming soon right?  Is that what you've been worrying about?

The baby is one problem, her boyfriend is another big one. I'm not sure he will be responsible about the baby and the costs. On the other hand, my sister and I are both still unemployed. e can't pay the costs for baby. I think he will leave my sister and this will really affects my sister mentally. I may apply for a job in NY and take my sister there to keep her away from this circumstance. Living in big cities has its own problems though.

Wow, I had no idea that her situation was so dire.  I really hope the best for you and your family, if there's anything I can do to help out just let me know.  If my sister and I make it to NYC maybe we can help you guys get a foothold there.

Thank you very much. I hope to get a chance to meet you both there. I will stay in touch with you to ask about the city. I wish you good luck for the tonight's play and also have good time at Knick's game.

If you were to get something organized at your school, what would you want to raise money for?

I'm down for that! I love checking out new places! Maybe you could pick me up from practice and that way you could meet my horse, maybe take a quick ride on him.
Awesome, I would love that.  How does next Saturday afternoon sound to you?  Maybe around 1:00 P.M.

personas: I want to help retired race horses.

dialog.text: I just got an invitation to sponsor for a charity run
That is amazing. I know you were planning on doing something with animals. Did you decide what you are going to do?
I would like to organize a fundraiser for rescuing retired race horses. a lot of times once they are past their prime they are put down. I hate to see that happen to them.

That makes so much sense. The therapeutic horse farm that my parents work at did a fun run but did it along the horse enclosure so that when the people ran by the horses would run along with the people. It was so cool!
That must have been wonderful to grow up around. I love riding horses competitively but I hate the darker side of it. Do you have any tips for raising money? You did so well with your fundraiser.
Yeah, that was mostly my parents doing. I wish I could ask them for some tips. I really miss them since they passed away and it has been much harder for me to raise large amount of money.
Understandable, How old were you when they passed away?

I was in my early twenties so, at least I was able to learn a lot from them. The best thing you can do for your fundraiser is try to do something original but, coming up with the idea is always the most difficult idea.
I am sorry for your loss! Maybe I could bring my horse to the fundraiser, if that is allowed. That should draw some attention!
Yeah, that sounds like a great idea! You could even ride the horse around at the fundraiser!
Fingers crossed that they would let me do that. If they do, my cousin harper can come ride with me too.
That would be amazing both of you on horses would get a lot of attention!

personas: I am thinking of booking a DJ for a fundraiser.

dialog.text: Is booking a DJ a good idea for the fundraiser in your experience?

Yeah I think its worth the cost. You might be able to find someone to do it for free if they care about the cause too. Music is important to get everyone in a good mood and for people to enjoy themselves. Just putting on the radio or a playlist won't be nearly as good
Ok thanks! Do you have any you would recommend me talking to?

There is a guy named Dan who did the last few runs I was on. He was really good, kept the crowd entertained, and seemed to play the perfect music for the situation. I don't know his last name or phone number but I can get it for you from someone else who was at the run. I can help you get sponsorship as well. Get any sponsors for the run yet?
Nice! Yes we've had a couple of good ones so far thanks, $1000!
Maybe I can bring my dog Harper over when I'm done with work tomorrow and we can go over some ideas. I know how much you love horses and I think you have a great idea to help raise money for them.
That sounds great! How is Harper?
Harper's been doing great. He's just getting out of his puppy phase. I bring him to the hospital whenever I go and the kids love him, and he loves the attention.
That's wonderful, I suppose they don't get to see many animals being stuck in the hospital?
They have a few therapy pets come by each month, but they all seem to like Harper the best.
Must be very satisfying for you! Schnauzers are beautiful dogs
I'd bring him to your charity race but I think he might spook the horses, or the horses would spook him.

dialog.text: I'm not too sore anymore, after my massage. I'm planning my next marathon already!

It's in a couple weeks. Hopefully the weather holds up, although I actually like running in the rain!
Omg, doesn't that make you shiver?
No, it actually cools me down a bit, as long as it's not pouring out too crazily. I come from the pacific northwest, so I'm used to it.
Ahaa, that's nice to hear. What do you usually take after completing your runs?
Whiskey. Neat. So how are your parents doing?
They are doing fine, I recently went and saw them. My father had a cold, but right now he is holding up well. I'm sorry about the loss of your mother.
It's okay. She lived to be 90. She lived a good life. Taught me a lot about the Depression growing up. Gave me a lot of inspiration to help people with their lives.

What else could I need in life other than such a parent. It was a life well lived. I hope you live by the statutes that she imparted on you. I would love to keep taking care of mine during these closing days of their lives.
Are they going to end up living with you?
Yes. I am almost securing a job near home, so that I can be with them often. Besides, I found a caregiver who would help take care of them whenever I am at work.

Yeah, you know even though it was a rough time, I sort of remember it fondly because of all the comics. I think I'll start reading them more. They're just so much fun. Have you done any sailing or anything recently ?
I did. I was on the water last week. I ended up catching some great trout. I couldn't wait to get home and cook them up. What type of fish do you like to eat?
I like them all basically. Salmon is a great and reliable. But I like just about anything. Any recommendations ?
The rainbow trough is, especially, good but can sometimes be a pain to find. I try to eat healthy because I want to start running soon. Have you run any marathons lately?
Not for a few months. I'm training right now for a new one. My time is close to the last one but it's rough getting there.
I am sure. Running seems fun, but difficult when you are trying to train for longer distances. Is there any recommended training I should be doing to prepare myself.
Just be realistic with yourself. You're not going to go from not running to running a 5 minute mile. Running a mile at first is a big accomplishment, even if it's 10 minutes or something.

I understand that completely. I love celebrating the small wins. I have been feeling stressed lately, so I figured running would be a good outlet. As a life coach, what advice do you give your clients when they are stressed.

It's a great outlet for stress. Nothing makes me feel more calm and ready to take on a challenge than a workout. The best thing you can do is find a good outlet for stress and mix that in with your daily life.

That is some good advice. I do feel calm and more focused when I exercise. There are also the amazing health benefits too. Is it harder to run now, after beating cancer?  I am sure that takes a huge toll on the body.

dialog.text: How many bike races have you won?
Quite a few actually! It was my life as a kid, and now my career as an adult. Do you think you'd get one of your grandkids into it, as the training wheels are coming off?

A lot of it, is listening to the kid, seeing where they are strong, and what they are interested in. I want to make sure my grand kids know how to use the breaks before I let them go on their own!  Love teaching confidence gradually to them.
That's great! How old is your bike riding grandkid?
He's just started school and is getting down the alphabet and the like. Need to find something to focus all that energy on. Do you have a workout routine for biking, regularly?

I do - a few miles every day in general, but when I'm training it's far more. I also do a lot of leg work. You may be interested in some biking holidays, actually, if you're looking for something like that.
Ah, something that might get the kid interested perhaps. If it's something that makes you happy, sure feel free to share the biking holidays!
My favourite 'track' (though not really a track exactly) is along the Venice Boardwalk. So much space, all that sea air!

Sounds intriguing. Do you plan your vacations around nice places to bike? I bet Europe would have a few great treks. Riding a bike in my neighborhood, that's just fine too. Where was your last holiday?
I do sometimes, but not always. Sometimes I like to have a chance to simply walk around. My last holiday was to Milan. The food is exquisite, as is the architecture. What about you?
I tend to stay within my region generally, and many times the kids help figure out the destinations. Been thinking about the new season, there are some great forests to explore for hiking and biking.
Sometimes the best places are right on our doorstep - that sounds amazing. Got any favourites specifically?

personas: I'm retired. I used to be petroleum engineer.

I work at a cafe. I usually bike to work.
I try to reduce my carbon footprint. I live in a place with bad traffic.
I'm comfortable on my bike.

dialog.text: Do you bike to work at the cafe?
Yes, most days I do.  If it's raining I don't because I need to not be sopping wet at work.  But otherwise that's my preferred way to commute.
That's good. It's an environmentally friendly way to get to work! I'm glad you're reducing your carbon footprint.
Yes, I definitely try to do that.  It can be a faster way to travel anyway.  Traffic around here can be pretty gnarly.
Certainly. Sounds like you're pretty comfortable being on a bike, too, so that must be a plus.
Yes, for sure.  Say, before you said that you were retired.  What did you used to do for a living?
I was a petroleum engineer, ironically. I'd go out to oil fields and offshore rigs and help design the processes used for petroleum extraction.
Oh wow, that's amazing.  Did you have a degree in petroleum engineering?  Or chemical engineering?
I got a degree in chemical engineering. Many schools didn't offer degrees in petroleum engineering back in the day.

Interesting.  I remember seeing a list of degrees and what their starting salaries were and chemical engineering was very high on the list.  I remember that because my uncle was a chemical engineer and he seemed to get paid pretty well.
Yep, it's a very high-paying job. The oil & gas industry is pretty far away from God's work, but it is lucrative,
That's what my uncle used to say, too!  They don't teach you to say that in school, do they?

What is your grandsons baseball team name?
He plays for a team called the Wildcats. How did you get in to coaching?

I'm glad things seem to be going well. What is your baseball team's name?
Our baseball team name is Pirates. The children like the idea of doing what they want so as a team we decided that the name will be of people with the most freedom and that happened to be a pirate.
That's an interesting philosophy for the naming of a team. Do you plan on having any more children?
I don't plan on having any more children. I wanna focus on the kids I have right now.

dialog.text: What sort of things do you like to sew?

I like to sew anything that I can! Pillowcases, quilts, designs on shirts and underwear. Ribbons for cancer survivors. It keeps me busy in my retirement. How is your Little League baseball league playing?
It is going great except that the parents like to run things to much.
I think that is normal. Parents are usually so proud of their kids playing abilities, even if they aren't that good haha. Which one of your 5 sons play on the team?
Just the 5 year old's and they really like it.  Now tell me more about yourself. What type of cancer did you have?
I am a survivor of breast cancer. I have been in remission for 30 years.
Wow, congratulations on being in remission for so long!  My husband is in remission from lymphoma so I can understand a little about it.  There is always fear that it will come back.
I find that the best way to put the fear of relapse to the back of your mind is just to focus on the small everyday things that make you happy, such as your little league and your sons.
Yes, keeping busy is what really helps.
I am sure with 5 sons you keep plenty busy! My grandchildren also keep me very busy as well. Are your twins lookalike twins?

Yes, his team is doing very well. I mean they have only won one game but they are learning the fundamentals they’re getting along and they are playing the right way so yes they’re doing well

That is good, at such a young age it's important for them to learn to work together and get a good foundation.  My grandson's team hasn't won any of their games this season, but he's so happy that it doesn't even matter.
Well if you gone by our families no one will worry about the future of baseball in America…

Baseball will also be around in America, plenty of people love it and the kids that are having fun today will get more and more competitive as they get older.  I just hope I'm around to watch my grandson's high school games.
Well you believe in Heaven don’t you? I mean whether or not you physically on this planet you are going to be watching your grandson play baseball
Yes, of course.  But I would like to be there in person to congratulate them and let them know of my support.
I wonder if they know how much we really love them? Can they even comprehend?

I think that deep down they know, even if they aren't yet mature enough to express it.  I think about how I feel about my own grandparents who have long since passed and I believe that they must feel similarly.
Yes you are so right! What I wouldn’t give to go fishing with my grandfather just one more afternoon… he passed away 18 years ago now.
Yes, that is why it is important to savor every day.  Each moment, no matter how mundane it feels at the time, is a special memory in the making.

Yeah a lot of people do say that they feel so much healthier and that is one of other reasons i want to do it. Especially now when then do so many non-meat items that are plant based.
I think it has to be realistic too. Otherwise I don't stick to the plan. I slip too sometimes. I hope your kitty is comfortable, I'll be thinking about them.
Yeah i will get there in the end. And thank you she is on pain killers but think she will go back to the vets in a few days.

One day at a time, with that kind of work. And grieving too. I need to take a break between pets. And my last pet had an expensive, protracted dying process, and I've taken a break since then. Looking forward to a pet again some day.
Yeah it really does take a toll. They are part of the family, it will be very strange without her around my i won't be getting another one for a long time.

A licensed nurse just follows me around and tells me what to do and supervises me so I get hands on experience.  It's better than being in a classroom but I can't wait until I can actually get paid to do it!
I'd imagine. Honestly, that sounds a like exploitative. You should at least get minimum wage or something!

Have you gone surfing again since your shark encounter?
I am not sure what you are referring too. I just work and eat all the time.
I thought you were in school to become a nurse like your mother. Is your diet over, I had thought you were eating less?
I finish school but I am working as a student now. I am still trying to diet but it is difficult. How are your dogs?
My labrador Agatha is doing fantastic. One of my client brought her a new york strip steak last night. She loves to bark at the neighbor's dog. Do they have any therapy dogs at the hospital?

Wow your clients really treat your dogs well. Hopefully they also bring you food. Yes there is an organization that will bring dogs to the hospital to sit with the clients. The dogs can't stay in the hospital but it is nice when they come visit.

Your dogs have more expensive taste than you they must be spoiled. Any job seems to have its challenges with clients. Nursing and bar tending seem like they would be so different but in reality they are both about making people feel comfortable. I made a lot of money as a bar tender and it can be fun sometimes its stressful it depends who the clients are.

Clients and customers can make or break a job. I never thought of the similarities between nursing and bartending in the terms you described. I mix cocktails for some of my clients in between recording sessions. It seems to loosen some of them up. Dirty martinis are my drink of choice. What's your favorite cocktail?

I think it is really important to have soft skills no matter what job you are in. Sometimes people are difficult because nobody has taken the time to listen to them its amazing what engaging in friendly conversation with someone can do to a persons mood. Yes a good drink can also help sometimes I like to experiment with drinks I am still working on perfecting one I don't have a favorite but I like to keep trying new things.

Almost everything I eat is from the crops I grow on my farm. My favorite thing to make is stew from my potatoe and onion crops. I add some beef to that and it is delicious.
That sounds amazing. I travel often, but have never visited a farm before. I think it would be fun to visit your farm , play with your dog, and try your stew. Is it hard running a farm by yourself?

It used to be hard but then I got into a routine for planting and tending my crops and now that I have a routine it can get a bit repetitive. I get so tired some days that I wish I could go on a vacation. You're lucky. You get to vacation in Spain. Did it take long to save up the money for that trip?

It did take a while, but traveling is worth it. I get to see so many new things and take in so much culture. It can also be exhausting too though, with time changes and not understanding the languages. I think we are both lucky in our own way, doing things we enjoy. I can't have a pet because I travle so much.

I know! Having a dog is great. I love mine so much. But when you want to travel it can be a big hassle because you either have to find a neighbor to watch your dog, or you have to put the dog in a kennel, which can be a lot of money depending on how long you are gone.

I would feel bad leaving a pet with someone. I do enjoy the freedom to get and and leave whenever I feel the urge. I work remotely, so I can work from anywhere. It is so relaxing to take my laptop and work from the beach, or a hotel room. One of my favorite parts of traveling though is the food. Good local food. You must love being able to walk outside, pick fresh food and eat prepare it right away. It must taste so good!

Are you taking anyone with you to Spain or are you going alone?

I don't date much because I travel so often, but once and a while I trave with the person I am dating. I guess I find it hard to settle down with a person, not too many people can up and leave their jobs as often as I do. I am looking for someone who wants to live a nomadic lifestyle like I do.

Oh, well then I hope you don't mind me asking, but since you have companion passes, do you think I could go along with you? Just as friends of course. We just have so much in common, and I'm at a good stopping point with my work at the farm, that I'd like to go on a vacation at this point. Don't worry, I understand if not. I just thought I'd throw that out there.

Don't drown? Just kidding! Probably not a lot I can offer you except to not try to do too much at one time. With all the running and now biking you do, you should have good lung capacity for swimming but it can be overwhelming if you try to go to fast at the beginning. Take your time. if your not use to running start out walking and each day try to increase your speed.   Stretching before and after is extremely important.  A 5k would be a good start if your use to running.  It will give you a sense of where your at with your abilty.

definitely Belle. i would say you aren't an expert on disney princesses with 5 sons though, right? what movies do they prefer?

You got that right haha!! I'm in the dark about them. Belle is the one who likes books right? They're into anything sports or action related although I encourage them to actually play the games not just watch them!
yes, she is! that is great. better to play and burn off the energy and get exercise. i get plenty of exercise walking dogs. do you like any kinds of exercise?

haha! I'm blown away that I actually knew that! I play baseball with friends, go hiking, and with the little pups I get plenty of exercise chasing them around to get shoes out of their mouths! Are you interested in other types of exercise or just walking?

oh that is true. dogs do love to chew shoes - luckily mine is too small to chew on too many things. nah, i am kind of lazy. i think i would spend too much time on my couch if it weren't for my job! maybe i should get some kids too to force me to be more active!  have you set up a time to try out kayaking yet?

i would recommend starting out on a small lake. you dont want to be too ambitious and try the ocean or a river, that can be dangerous! do you think your sons would be interested to try?

Haha! I was thinking of diving right in to a bumpy river with a trainer, but I guess you would know best how to start things out. The boys do want to come but I think my buddy and I are going to head out and get the hang of it first! My kids won't let me live it down if they see me tip

dialog.text: How's training for the marathon going?
Its going great so far.  I'm trying to increase my time and distance gradually to avoid injury.  How far do you usually run?
I like to run short distances, definitely not anything like you're doing. I ran cross-country in high school. I've been dealing with a lot lately, so running helps blow off steam.
Oh wow, so sorry to hear that.  Anything you want to talk about?
Oh, nothing new than what I've already told you. Work is a nightmare. I'd rather talk about other things. How are your cats? I love my new kitten.
I only have one cat named Jackson.  He's great, and so funny.  He always keeps me entertained.  That's awesome you rescued a  kitten!  Tell me about it.
I'd much rather hear more about your marathon! What city is it in?
Charlotte.  It is to support cancer research.  I have lost several family members to cancer.
That's great you're participating in something to memorialize them like that. Are you worried about the summer heat in North Carolina? How do marathon runners stay cool?

Well, it starts early in the morning.  7 am.  There are lots of hydration stations along the route, which help.  For me, knowing it is going to keep getting hotter as time passes makes me run faster...lol!
That's a good way to think of it! Do you have one of those water backpacks? I used to run with one of those in the summer.
No, but that's a great idea!  I may have to look into that!

dialog.text: I just rescued a black kitten and thought of you. Any desire to adopt a new cat?
I love black cats! Is it a boy or a girl?
It's a girl and she is the most playful thing I've ever seen.  Just wants to play and be with people.
She sounds adorable. Sometimes I worry that my cat Jackson gets lonely when I'm at work. Is the cat at your rescue or have you been fostering it at home?
I am fostering and think that she needs a cat mentor to teach her the ropes.  Right now she thinks she's a person.
Haha, I'd love to give her a forever home. I'll come by this weekend if you're free. How are things at the shipyard?
Shipyard is crazy.  Remember that ship that was stuck in the Suez canal?  It just came in for repairs!

No way! The Ever Given. That was insane how much commerce that blocked up. I heard it was the bulbous bow that got stuck in the bank that made it such a problem to get loose. Is there a lot of damage?
Not too much damage, but even when there is limited damage, we are required to do a full check of the entire ship and this one is massive
Sounds like a lot of work! At least it's job security. Did you do the same kind of work when you were in the military?

Similar, but worked on air craft carriers.  Those are huge also.  There was once a family of bunnies living in the engine room for years before they were discovered!  That's were I acquired my love for them.
That's remarkable, a family of bunnies living on an aircraft carrier. Bunnies are adorable and delicious, like pigs.

personas: I'm having trouble with the Egyptian government.

dialog.text: I just heard from a coworker that a person claiming to be a representative of the Egyptian government came by the yard with some kind of warrant-like document claiming that they have a right to seize the Ever Given. It's NUTS. No one knows how to figure out if he's legit or not.
Wow that is nuts! I think you can start by calling someone in local government. They should be able to direct you to find out!
Yea I think that would be best. Also do my diligent research online as well.
Yeah, look up as much as you can! How long do you have before they try to seize it? I don't get why the Egyptian government would want it.

We have tomato, corn, wheat, watermelon, potato, etc. We have little bit of everything. We own quite a  chunk of land and it can take quite a while to care for. Have you been interested in agriculture before?

That's impressive! I haven't thought about agriculture in depth before. I am interested in biology though, but more on the natural systems and genetics topics. When I go to college, i want to study physical therapy, but i could change my mind. What was your favorite class in college.
My favorite is biology, but the biology I study is for the crops. I study the photosynthesis process. Is there anything new you've learned recently in your class?
What a coincidence! We just learned about plant biology and went over the photosynthesis process. Do you also have animals on your farm?

We have milk cows, pigs, and horses. I've been flung off of a few with only a minor concussion. I wouldn't give it up for anything, though. I love the way it feels and the wind in my hair. Are there any activities you participate in that give you a sense of a freeing feeling?

That must have been painful. I hope that doesn't happen too often. Concussions are dangerous! I love running. It gives me this feeling that I don't have to worry about anything in the moment. That's why my dad and I are training for a marathon.
That's sounds exhausting. I've never been a huge fan of running. I never understood the whole runner's high thing. How do you do it? Lol

Honestly, you just start somewhere and go for as long as you can! I love the feeling of accomplishment when I've completed a good long run. Do you feel a sense of accomplishment when you have a good crop season?
I feel a sense of accomplishment when I get to donate the extra crop we have. I love helping people. It's hard and honest work. I love my community.
That's so nice. I should look into opportunities to give to my community. I thin k it would look good on my college applications. Did you volunteer in high school?

dialog.text: What do you miss most about those good ol' teenage years?
I guess mainly just how dumb and naive one can be and doing or saying anything without worrying about the consequences of our actions.

Ha! Don't I relate. I used to love just being able to say "screw it," shut out the world, and hang out with my friends, listening to Britney Spears. Now we only have hobbies when we have the time. Are you gonna chill anytime soon, maybe go to a national park again?
I'm happy to hear I'm not the only one!!! Britney is the bomb, right? Funny that you mention it, next week I'm going with a couple of friends to Yellowstone, have you ever been there?
Darn right, she is! That sounds fantastic! I've never been there. Do you usually go with friends, or do you do solo trips, too? If I go, I can't decide if I'd rather be alone or not.

I like going with at least someone else, it can go from fun to not-so-fun very quickly if you happen to get stranded or lost or without reception. It happened to me once when visiting the Grand Canyon. I truly felt that was the end

Oh, God, that sounds terrible. I think that place is too big for me, anyway. I'd always feel like I'm either about to trip off of a cliff, or be turned around and get lost. Did you have a guide on your first time? I think that might make me feel safer.

I had the same feeling but didn't trust my instincts. I went there thinking it would be pretty easy to not gets lost, and 36 hours after I was suffering the consequences. If I'm talking to you today is because the hostel I was staying reported me as a missing person. A guide or just a going with a group in your first treks is the best choice, trust me.

Oh, Jesus. That's like something from a movie. I'm glad you're still okay and with us. Taking that into account, and how sluggish my new diet-change is going, I think it may be a while before I feel up to that, haha. You know, an upcoming trip that I'd like to make is to a concert. Its been forever since I've been. We should go see Rascal Flats sometime--get you to brush up on them.

Yeah, that's what I was thinking of! But I didn't even want to mention it, since it's so grizzly. And a true story. Heck yeah, that sounds great! You know my favorite, so I'd love to be formally introduced to your favorite at a concert!
Of course! We can do a double date and enjoy some relax time together and share with you guys in more detail my other crazy stories when going on treks!

I used it years ago and it was free.  And yes, traveling definitely helped with my Spanish, but I may use the app as a refresher before I travel to Italy.  Any recommendations of things to do while in Italy if I bring my family there one day?

Great, well I'll definitely look into Duolingo then. And as there's an app it'll be useful to do on my phone when I get a free moment! In terms of where to go in Italy, I'd recommend the area in the north around Lake Garda as it's just beautiful and there are lots of towns to visit. Tuscany is also lovely with all its rolling hills and vineyards. If your family is into art then Florence is good choice too!

Thanks for all of those recommendations - that's really helpful!  I enjoy art, but my kids sometimes get bored by it.  What type of art are you most interested in?  I enjoy nature photography and painting.

Ha yes I can imagine that the kids might get bored in art galleries! I also enjoy nature photography, and portrait photography too. I'm not very good at painting though! What type of painting do you do (e.g watercolor, acrylic etc)?

I like oil painting the most, but I tend to use acrylics more often because the smell of the turpentine needed to get oil paint out of the brushes is really nasty! I don't want to use such a harsh chemical around the kids.
I hadn't thought about how hard it must be to get oil paint out of a paintbrush, I can understand why you don't want to always have to get out the turpentine! What type of thing to you like to paint?

so far I just take them. I should probably do something with them though. I have some pretty cool pictures.

I toss in a head of lettuce or two, but giraffes aren't really great at reaching the ground with those long necks either, even though he's so low to the ground by comparison.

Sounds good. You're not too far off from most of the up-front people on my team, hehe. Trial and error, after all.

Haha, yeah. Maybe a good team needs both: fast people and smart people, haha. Maybe you think too much to run fast, too. Do you think a lot about how you run, and how you breathe, and how fast the other people are? That might make you slower.
Well, that may be the reason I cannot win a race. What do you think of when running? Your turtles or something?

dialog.text: I vacuumed my entire main floor to get rid of the cat fur.

Animals are beautiful aren't they!! But oh the hair!! Do you think you and your wife will take the chance and get a pet?
I believe we will, and probably a cat this time.  Any recommendations?  Is it better to get a male or a female?
I prefer the females. They don't seem to want to get away as much as the males. Do you know where you'll buy from? There are some good rescue shelters in NY.
I'm sure I will get a rescue.  I don't know a lot about cats.  Do different ones have different temperaments, like dogs?

My best advice is, it doesn't matter the breed....it's the personality. Go to the shelter and spend some time there or even a couple of shelters. I'm a true believer in, you'll know when it's a right fit. I mean ya, you could focus on the breed, but you might miss out on some pretty amazing options.
That's very true, and a great idea.  I will do that.  I have had that happen with dogs I rescued in the past.  You just know when you find a good one, and have a connection.
Right! Sometimes it's you that gets picked!!! I am really excited for you guys! It will be so fun!! Have you picked up any supplies yet, or are you still in the planning stages?

Lol!! You got that right! Make sure you ask at the shelter for good recommendations for a vet. They'll probably send you home with a bag of goodies from the shelter. I'd probably wait and see what they give you. Watch what the kitty kat plays with and then go from there. As far as food I'd go with what the shelter gives you. Chewy.com is always a great source to go to also!
Great!  Thank you for the information.  I'm looking forward to it.  I may even grow to prefer cats....lol

The deer are actually quite timid. They usually don't come close to the farm, and they mostly eat the berries and shrubs that grow in the woods.
Really? I have always heard that farmers have a hard time keeping the deer out of the crops.
Yup, the ones around here are not bothersome, which is quite nice. I think they get scared off from all of the loud noises the farm equipment makes. Are there lots of deer in Colorado too?

oh yeah, turkeys, goats, bears, mountain lions.  You name it and we've got it.  That's one of the things I love about my state.  But tell me about the animals on your family farm.

Yes,  my dogs don't like the heat either. I guess it's the fur. Luckily, they like water, so we go hiking near lakes and rivers. It cools them off. Are your cats on leashes outside or in carriers or just free to roam?

dialog.text: How does your son feel about him being in college and you about to have twins?
Well needless to say he is not very happy because he was an only child and spoiled to say the least.
I can understand that, but with such a big age gap he can't be that demanding of your attention while you're raising the twins.  Or can he?

Oh no not demanding of my attention. Just demanding of my pocket book! LOL He is afraid the twins will receive more money than he will. He is hoping not to have to work to hard until I kick the bucket and he is afraid his inheritance will lessen.

Haha, I would tell him that your money is yours and you'll decide how much he gets! And while you're at it, I'd also say that he needs to get a job while he's in college if he needs spending money.  That's just me though.
That is exactly what I told him. You must be excited with your grandchildren coming soon?
Of course! I am so excited to have some little ones running around again! It's nice too because if they misbehave I'm not the one who has to deal with it, haha.
Exactly the way I feel being a grandparent. It's weird I'm a grandparent and going to be a parent again. What was I thinking? LOL!

Well your twins will always have friends in your grandkids, haha.  I know one of the most challenging aspects of parenting is finding a good set of friends who will be a good influence.  It sounds like you might have that covered!

I'm hoping that is the case. Raising two children again will definitely be a challenge at my older age. I was 18 when I had my son and now 38 with twins. I'm excited for the chance to raise these two little humans a bit different than my son. Hopefully they will value more of what they have that isn't tied to monetary images.

You're in pretty good physical shape though.  I think you'll be just fine dealing with the twins!  And it seems like a nice opportunity to impart all the wisdom you've accumulated since having your first son.
Yes the older I get the more wiser I get when it comes to life in general.

I would definitely try some of the local favorites that you never hear about.  Especially in Kenya!
What makes Kenyan food special do you think?

It's just that local food is so different from what we are used to. There are grubs they gather from trees, for example, that when combined with the right spices and vegetables taste every bit as good as filet mignon.
You know I've never had filet mignon. What is it?

It's an overly priced cut of beef you can get in 4 star restaurants.  Personally, I prefer the simpler approach to food.  Food is so subjective.  I wish I could cook the way you can.  I'd be experimenting all the time!

They all look fiddly to me since I can't cook! lol But I'd probably eat anything you could make.  Even with the spicy vegetables you like.
You know you're still young! For someone who loves a lot of dishes, if you can get hold of a kitchen you can learn to cook. Just keep trying!

Oh how fun! I've always enjoyed the best friend characters in romcom most. Is Reese playing the lead?

Yes, Reese is playing the lead. I am really nervous because I will be reading lines with her and don't want to mess up. Have you ever thought about acting? My boyfriend may be able to set up an audition for you!

I'm so excited for you! I would be so nervous too but I'm sure you'll do great. I haven't thought much about acting, I don't think anybody would hire someone like me. Is your boyfriend in the business?
Yes he is a producer for Paramount and actually helped to get me this audition. I know he would help you too if you wanted it.

I've heard of it but haven't looked into it before. what is it?

You select a certain amount of hours you can eat in. Eat whatever you want in those hours. usually like an 8 hour period, and then the other 16 you eat nothing at all. So like you can eat from 8 A.M. to 4 P.M. but nothing after or before that.
that sounds interesting. I might be able to do that.

You just have to decide what times you prefer to eat. Like if you never eat breakfast, set your time later in the day. If you have to get up and be at work by 5 am and have to have your coffee, then you just set it early, and try to get to bed early since your food time ends before late evening.

dialog.text: Hold off on that watch I was wanting a bear ate my snowshoes, luckily I wasn't wearing them at the time.
A bear ate your snowshoes?

Lucy the bear didn't eat you. That's a good thing.

I do feel very blessed to enjoy this earth another day. It does serve as a reminder, though, of how precious time is. Do you feel like clocks make our short lives feel even shorter, or help live each moment with intention? Is that why you got into the watch business?
They sure show you that time passes faster than we sometimes want. I found the design of watches to be mathematically incredible. But math is not my strong point. Heh.
No? What would you say is your strong point?
I really don't know. I only know that I have always had a problem with fractions. However, I do enjoy geometry.

I understand. Geometry can be very enjoyable to study, especially for someone who enjoys seeing math represented in the physical world. I have two thoughts that may help with how you perceive and work with fractions. May I share them?
By all means, do so.

My first thought is that fractions are our friend. They enjoy keeping your work tidy. For instance, while a decimal might decide to repeat into infinity, a fraction is compact and stays put. 1/3 instead of .33333333333333, for instance. My second thought, and this is more of a question for you to consider, is would fractions seem more friendly if you always applied them to shapes? For instance, instead of 1/5, perhaps one star arm.
One star arm. That's an interesting thought.

dialog.text: I decided to go play tennis at a local court yesterday with a couple of friends, and I think it went well. I wasn't very good at it, but I think I got the hang of it towards the end. I would be interested in taking some classes to get better at it, could you teach me as well?
That's awesome! Of course I am happy to teach you so you can learn. We can take it slowly at first, seeing as I'm pregnant too. Who won during your game yesterday?
I definitely did not win but I scared my opponent a few times with some really fast shots. how long after the birth do you think you will be back playing at full capacity?

I'm sure you did, that's awesome! You'll get better in to time. You know what they say, right? Practice makes perfect! Probably a couple of weeks. I can't want to be able to be fully active again, and it will help me lose the pregnancy weight!
Yes it will be a really good way to get back to a normal weight again. I remember mine taking ages to shift after my kids!
Exactly, and exercising is always much easier when it's something you enjoy. Really? Yeah, it's difficult to lose that baby belly. Just how long did it take for you to back to your normal weight?
About 4 years but I never really got my eating back under control for a while. I wish I had an active hobby like yours at the time as it would have helped lots.
Oh wow, that's quite a long time! That's very true, I really enjoy keeping active as much as I can. I almost forgot to ask, how is the music teaching going?
It is going very well. One of the students is definitely going to be a star one day. He can just pick up any instrument and get a good sound of it straight away.
He sure sounds talented! I wish I took the time to learn an instrument when I was younger, I think it would be so cool to be able to play. I think I'd have chosen the guitar or the drums!
You can still start now. The best thing is to just get started and give it a try.
I suppose it's never too late! You're right. Maybe we can teach an old dog, new tricks! Perhaps in exchange for tennis lessons, you could teach me how to play sometime?

it's true that it is your body, but doing certain things while pregnant can cause complications for you and your baby.

Enjoy the baby stage even when it's hard. it goes so quickly and soon they will be teenager who is talking back and thinking you are super uncool.

There you go. You could always find a new angle to use your tennis skills if you can't play competitive tennis. By the way, have you picked out a name for your baby yet?

It is a slow and spooky tune and first, then it transitions to really upbeat and happy. I think you will like it.
Oh I love songs with those sorts of transitions, sounds like I will love it. Once you're finished a song, do you take a little break to reset or are you on to the next piece of music?
I just press on! When the inspiration strikes I must seize it! Sometimes I get writers block though.

True you definitely need to make the most of it. I'm having really bad writer's block at the moment, actually. Hopefully once I get back into my place and things calm down I will start feeling inspired again.

dialog.text: Well, my Toyota broke down today so I really need to make a decision about that motorbike sooner rather than later.

Yeah that's smart, you'll save a lot on gas too!  Are you going to wear a helmet?
Oh yes.  I am going to go with a full face helmet and full leathers - leather jacket and leather chaps over my jeans!  I think it looks good on top of helping me stay safe.
Wow, you're going to look super sharp with that getup! Any ideas on where you'll get lessons?
I was looking at a class at the local community college.  They offer it on Sundays every week. Where did you learn to ride?

That's interesting, I had no idea that colleges taught that sort of thing.  I learned from a buddy of mine who had been riding since he was a kid.  I'm sure he'd be willing to help you if you're interested!

Thanks.  I looked online to find where I could learn.  The college has an adult learning program.  Classes for real life skills - I took a cooking class and loved it!  They have everything from cooking to taxes to riding a motorcycle.  Your friend should consider teaching there.
That's so cool! Do they require any credentials or just experience? My buddy is always looking for side jobs, but I don't think he has any formal education.

They don't need any formal degree or certifications.  They are always looking for teachers.  The pay is not great, but you can take other courses for free!  I taught an art class so I could take the cooking class for free.

dialog.text: The doctors just told me that I do need surgery on my leg!

Oh I'm so sorry to hear that. Once the surgery is over you will rest and be back to your normal self. Back to self discipline and getting ready for the Olympics. That has to be something you look forward to right?

I suppose.  We'll have to see.  They are going to put a pin in my leg and the long-term prognosis is unclear.  Getting back to training is too far in the future to think about.  Right now I'm just worried that the surgery will go okay.  It's happening in two days.
I'm sure that the surgeons will be highly skilled and you will recover quickly. But in the mean time watching Queer Eye will give a few laughs and maybe keep your mind off from the surgery.

Yes, I definitely need something to keep my mind off heavier things.  I hadn't watched my first episode yet before getting hurt, but now I have lots of time.  I was going to ask you whether your and your wife have any kids?
No we don't have any children. Thank goodness because our time is consumed with my bee farm and her modeling. She travels extensively.
Yes, that's sort of why I asked.  I figured your schedules would make it difficult.  Although, I bet you could use some extra hands helping with the bees.
Oh yes I definitely could use an extra hand but really can't afford to pay someone at the present time. But I'm thinking about teaching kids how to handle and raise bees.
That sounds fun.  I bet a lot of people would like to learn to do that.  Especially as bees become less common in our yards and gardens, I think beekeeping's mystique is growing.
Yes I believe it is going to be exciting and I think that once kids learn the trade they will continue it for many years. Do you like bees?
I think bees are an invaluable species and I like seeing big, fuzzy bumblebees buzzing around, but swarms of them make me a little anxious, and I have no desire to be stung by a bee.
Yes being stung is no fun. I think it is important to keep raising bees so that they can be plentiful for our gardens and make honey. My wife and I also love the honey they are producing.
