And it's worth it to join the military?
Yes! There is a lot of skills to be learned by  being in the military. Not just job skills, but life skills as well, like discipline.
That is true. I need more discipline in my life as i'm more of a layabout these days
You can start giving yourself a headstart by waking up to an alarm every morning and creating a schedule for yourself--like when you will eat and shower
Yeah. I guess if you join the military you definitely need to start making sure your butt is out of bed at a specific time

Yeah. I wonder if college and health is the real incentive of it all. Like other countries just have that stuff for free already, but we bundle it with our military here
It is definitely an incentive to join  the military, even if it's only to learn those skills and receive the compensation

No matter what though, I have to wait until my arm is completely healed and then do some physical therapy.  I'm hoping that it doesn't give me any issues in the long run.

Middle ground is always good. From one extreme to the other is always hard. I bet that you meet some interesting people as a waitress!
Definitely. I meet my fair share of you-know-whats that make life difficult, too, ha! How's Florida been treating you?
It's hot and humid.  Winters are nice - summers are too hot at sticky.  Thank goodness for air condtioning.  But I guess I can't complain - it's gotta be even hotter in Cairo
It's very very very hot here, that's for sure! Is it true there are alligators in Florida? I saw footage of one just walking across a golf course once! Crazy!

Yes, it is.  Don't let your small dogs go wondering around by the water for sure.  I prefer the ocean and not the lakes.  There are no alligators in the ocean  :)  What kine of motorcycle do you drive?
That's absolutely crazy! And I drive a classic Harley. If only some genius could come up with a helmet that doesn't mess up my hair, I'd make them a millionaire!
Ha! Harley has been around for over 100 years, and they still haven't figured out a helmet that doesn't give you helmet head.  And I think they never will

Yes, I have been very lucky at the tables lately.  But you have to bet big to win big

I take my dog to the beach and we go watch the birds and the other people enjoying the view.
I can’t wait until I’m where you are at. I really need to retire soon. I hope afterwards we can spend some time by the ocean.

Retirement isnt all that its cracked up to be. I go to the beach to get my head clear. Cabin fever can settle in sometimes since there isnt anything to do anymore aside from normal household things. It would be nice to have another person to spend the time with.
I’m struggling to make it all work though, I feel I really need a change Kim. I’m ready to take my bike and just get away for a while.

When I was younger I told my boss I needed to reorient my outlook on life because it was affecting my performance. He gave me time to go out into the wilderness and hike and clear my head for a month in the colorado rockies. It was definitely worth it and most of the things I learned on that trip were also things I apply when I get too bored now.
You should come over and we can grill out, catch up, and just spend some time relaxing off our feet. I know you have been busy but I hope we can make it happen soon.
I would love to once the CDC clears everything. This virus has made retirement even more boring with there being nothing to go out and do.
Maybe the casinos are open I know you always liked going to gamble and have some fun.
Ive seen some of their daytime TV commercials and they do look like they are starting to reopen. Most of them are turning into vaccine locations though and I would hate to make others nervous.
We just need to do something Kim, maybe just stop down when I’m done waiting tables and we can have a few drinks.
I dont know if I can make the trip to Cairo.

dialog.text: Do you still go hiking in retirement?
Not so much now that I'm older. Between the sweat and my joints, I haven't been out in a few months. Jackie, my pup, and I take walks along the beach every now and then, though. You'd love it.
Oh yes I do love the beach. When I want to escape Cairo, Sharm-el-Sheikh on the Red Sea is calling!
Ahh, that sounds lovely. How are you fitting in there at Cairo? I know you mentioned work was busy.
Yes. More tourists because it's the summer, but somehow the cafe owners laid off some staff because they're "getting old".
My goodness! Reminds me of my days working for airlines. You should take a break in the off season, come visit. I'll grill your favorite.
Sure. I love American style hamburgers, can't get them authentic in all of North Africa it seems. Say, when you worked for airlines, were there unsavory characters?

Anything for you dear. And unsavory characters? I'd say quite a few! You meet all kinds of people as a stewardess, you know. It's why I ended up taking a break when I was younger! I just couldn't stand the rude folks, you know?
Me neither. When people stare longer than a tenth of a second at my pale skin, they think tourist moneybag.
Poor thing! I guess Cairo isn't all roses and sunshine, then. I never understood why people had such prejudices.
Yes, the land of tuk-tuks for the people and Harleys for rebellious women. I wish I was like you, at least for a day, in a country where women working high class jobs is admired.
America isn't that great either. When I was young, women had to work twice as hard as men to get the same pay. The grass is always greener.

Yes, I would agree with you! I am so glad that your sick cat is doing better. Does he play with the laser pointer still?

Yes, that's how I knew the cat was better, he started engaging with the laser pointer again.  The same cat has also now started to bring me tributes (i.e. mice) from the field behind my property, so I know he is well.
Oh boy! Well I hope he doesn't bring any in the house, Haha! Do all the cats you have get along or do they fight back and fourth?
For the most part, they get along.  I do call one of them Chuck, like Chuck Norris because he is always swatting his paw like a karate move.
Well, hopefully as time goes on, he begins to stop fighting and swatting with everyone. Are the cats you have outdoor or indoor cats?
Only one of them is strictly indoors because no claws.  The others all go out at dusk to "hunt".  Sometimes I get worried when the are out because there are coyotes in the area.
I would agree with you. I sometimes get worried about bubbles because I won't see him for a day or two then he will come back home.

I would come back home too for home cooked meals! They are lucky as most cats get their food from a can!

I'm glad you are recoverying well! I have an event scheduled in 2 weeks from this Friday. I am so excited. My buddy and I both race, we have a bet for this one. Have you ever ridden a motorcycle?

this one is on pavement. If you cant ride a motorbike, maybe you should attend a race, It is really thrilling. What kind of hobbies do you have?

I did. I think it's worth it as it's pretty safe for the dog and most dog owners know about the program so hopefully they would take it to get checked out if he goes missing

oh yeah...he's a feisty chihauhua and he's a little terror

dialog.text: any updates on your decision on getting a dog?
I've been looking at breeds on youtube, trying to figure out if I'll get a breed dog, or a shelter dog maybe. Where did you get your dogs?
Shelter. So many shelter dogs out there and I can't stomach the fact that they get put down if no one takes them. A dog is the best companion there is
Maybe could be a mix of both. I've learned that cats that are black at the shelter, get adopted less, due to superstition. Also need a breed that maybe doesn't need miles of walking a day.
I've heard that as well. Black cats are gorgeous though. I'm not sure what dog doesn't require that much walking as they are so energetic to begin with

In my research, several breeds of dogs, especially smaller dogs, are less in need of physical exercise, than other breeds. Border collie for example, would pass on that, although loved one in the past. What are your dogs like?
he's a german shepard and he's super strong. He's almost 10 years old but he can still pull me wherever he wants me to go on our walks
German shepherds have great personalities. They can be really big sometimes too!
Oh yeah he's a monster. If you could find a german shepard in the shelter I would suggest getting one
I appreciate your thoughts there. For my home and life, that would be too big. Medium or small size for this home! Wonder if they have smaller bred German shepherds. I'd consider that.
There is a similar breed to the german shepard that I think is smaller. They used one in John Wick 3
Maybe I'll check that out. Have yet to see that movie. I appreciate these days, they are kinder to animals in movies, from what I hear.

dialog.text: Now that I've finished my thesis I think I'll finally have time to go out kayaking again.
I bet that is very exciting. I hope you have an amazing time. Where will you go to do that at?
I will probably travel to Utah and California, I heard there is great kayaking there.
I am glad you know where you are headed! When will you get your grade on the Thesis? Are you going crazy waiting on it?
I'm not too worried, I've done the best that I can and I'm pretty sure it's going to be an A. I'm probably one of the smartest people ever to exist in the whole galaxy.
It is refreshing to see someone so confident in their intelligence, but the galaxy? That is a bit out there. (Man I love puns.)
But that brings up the debate, are aliens... people? What do you think? Can only humans be people? It's pretty broad around here, I even read that some people think corporations are people! hahaha

It probably depends. What is considered alien? Like if the aliens are made up of similar genetic coding and/or have the same basic make up as us, then would they be people? Or would them being from another place make them alien and therefore keep them from being considered people? I don't know. Now if they were like, I don't know, talking bears... Well then they wouldn't be people, but also not quite animal.

Perhaps it's a broad term that will never be completely defined. It will ebb and flow with the constructs of mankind's governance and culture. Personhood really becomes the dilemma. Do alien beings deserve human rights? Do humans deserve Alien rights? Should all life have equal rights, regardless of the perceived rank in some kind of natural order?

Yeah, those are all great questions. And depending on what is decided, which aliens would it cover? There is a book series that I absolutely love, and wish was more age appropriate for my students. It is called Acorna. The Author has made up evil aliens that are like giant beetles that kill everything they come into contact with, a planet with only plant life, that secretes this stuff to kill off any non planet organic stuff, and even alien singing stones that are actually able to speak to each other and that make a different sound. So would the stones be looked at as a thing even if proven sentient, and even if the plants were considered to have equal rights? It is all a lot to think about.

That sounds so intriguing! Would you want to possibly observe one of my elementary school classes sometime?
If possible! We would have to send out consent forms, if that's okay?!

I will send you an email next week with a formal plan. Thanks for helping! What is the most popular board game among your classes?
They really like to play Dominoes if that counts!

Yeah, I definitely try to avoid screens in the classroom. I want to make sure the students are focused and alert while class is in session.

dialog.text: I just complete my thesis. The scientific article really help that.
Congratulations!! How long does it take to get the thesis approved and receive your PhD?
Well usually it takes about a year and a half to finalize the thesis with the help of peer review and mentor review. What sort of books do you encourage your 3rd graders to read?
Charlottes Web and books by Judy Blume are easily digested at that age. Those books also are great for giving subtle life lessons. What books do you enjoy?
I enjoy autobiographies during my leisure time and delve into science journals more often. Do you think kids should read more non-fiction than fictional books from an early age?

That's a great question. I think because children at that age have rapidly expanding minds, the fantastical is often given to push boundaries of imagination. A lot of non-fiction books can be quite dense, even those aimed at younger readers.
Well that's true non-fiction books can dense and dry for young minds. Although do you think books help kids in developing non-verbal communications?
I think they are great in laying the foundation for critical thought and creativity. To start question how the world functions and the dynamics of social relationships, if only at a surface level.

Well creativity is what young kids master very early considering all the different media at their disposal. That's why schools and teachers like you have a hard time making them understand the facts of the present world and rightly said "the dynamics of social relationships". It must be real tough time for you to control their ever-expanding imaginations right?!?

The horses need love too so that works! I think I have a saddle that would fit her.

We have 5 total ranging from a 1 year old up to a 7 year old. Speaking of horses.. how did your horse ranch visit go? Did the kids love it?

Oh that's great. Yes, we did and we're actually planning to come back next month. Rachel my oldest who's 9 enjoyed them quite a bit, actually reminded me when I was young and I was excited to be around horses

Oh I remember being a child and wanting horses! My dad always said I Could have one in 3 weeks. Then three weeks would go by and I would ask again and he would say in 3 weeks.. and that kept on for 3 years until all of a sudden I had one and then several within a couple months!

Oh that's a bit sad to hear but I'm happy how it turned around. Three is the lucky number then! Rachel said as well "Mommy can we have a horse pretty please?". I don't want to be the bad cop, but also don't want to deceive her so I told her that was not an option but we compromised on visiting the ranch more often and I think that's a win-win for everyone
It must have been hard going to the horse ranch carrying twins though. I couldn't imagine even wanting to move at all while being pregnant. How far along are you now?

16 weeks! So is still very manageable. For obvious reasons didn't ride the horse or took part of some of the ranch activities, but otherwise I didn't have any problem with the long walks. Do you any plans with growing a family in the future or is the farm taking too much of your time these days?

Right now the farm takes so much time from me that I'm not sure if it would be selfish to start a family. I don't think I'd have enough time to be the proper parent I should be so I'm on the fence. I barely get to leave the farm as it is and certainly no longer than a couple of hours or so.
Yes, I can understand. I was the same way before. There are some trade-offs in life that one needs to make. But hey, you do you, and as long as what you're doing brings you happiness then why bother!
That's exactly how I see. There is a Greta concert coming up though so I'm debating going to it. Have you been to one?

dialog.text: I was thinking about places in Alaska that is good to visit for spiritual folk, and I am happy to make some recommendations for you. For starters, I recommend seeing and being near the Mendenhall Glacier.

Thanks for the recommendation, I've just looked it up and it seems beautiful. I find mountainous places really calming, for example I've been to the Austrian Alps before. Have you ever been to the Alps?
I have never been to the Austrian Alps, but I have heard of them! Can you tell me more about it? I'm sure it's beautiful!

Well the Alps themselves stretch across parts of France, Switzerland, Austria and Italy. Once of the most famous places is probably Chamonix in France, as that's where Mont Blanc is (they highest mountain in Europe). It's also a really famous place for skiing, though I've never been skiing before. Have you?

Wow! Sounds much more extensive than I initially thought! What do you do when you visit there? I love skiing, yes. It can be challenging at first, but it really is a lot of fun once you get enough practice in. I used to ski a lot when I was a teenager.

The few times I've been to the Alps we've visited various towns and gone on excursions to glaciers and ice caves and all sorts. I wish I had tried skiing when I was a bit younger, I'm worried about hurting myself now! Though I'm sure I'd be ok if I took it slowly. Would I need to buy all the skiing gear before going or can you hire it when you're there?

You can rent all of the skiing gear when you go, so don't even worry about buying any. That way you aren't wasting your money if you end up not liking it and never want to ski again. Just take your time and practice, practice, practice. Don't feel pressured to go down the larger hills at first. You'll get there eventually.

That's really useful to know, thank you. I was a bit worried about spending lots of money if I only used it once! I'll have a think about whether I can get a ski trip in over the next couple of years; I should really add it to my bucket list. And I will avoid the larger hills at first; someone I know was forced by their brother to go down a tricky one almost immediately and he had a bad crash!

Oh no! Were they okay? Or did they get hurt? I have heard many horror stories about skiing accidents- lots of broken bones and even death sometimes. Being careful is so incredibly important. Safety first!
Safety first for sure! Miraculously they didn't break anything but they were very bruised. Their brother felt awful for ages afterwards!

I'm glad they were okay. Wow, I'm sure that was very scary for them. I can't wait to hear how your skiing trip goes in the next few years! You're going to love it. I just know it. And if not, at least you'll be seeing some beautiful scenery.
Haha that's true, at the very least I'll be able to be up in the mountains (and enjoy a beer at the lodge in the evening)! I'll have to start planning both a skiing trip and my trip to Alaska!

dialog.text: I was about to make a burger but my boyfriend came home early from work lol.
What did your boyfriend want you to eat today?

Just a salad, nothing else. Though I should say ex-boyfriend, since we finally broke up. Some friends have been showing me how abusive and controlling his rules about my food habits were, and I finally ended it.
Oh wow are you still living together with your boyfriend? I really like to eat a salad with fresh vegetables from my farm but it could be topped with a burger and it would be a burger salad.

No, I'm moving in with some friends for the short term and I'm gonna figure something out in the future. It's for the best though, I hadn't been attracted to him for a while, and I might actually ask out a girl I like a bit more, though I'm still shell shocked from this break up. And I think eating is about balance, you can have a burger one day and a salad the next.

It is good to wait some time before moving on even though it sounds like you already knew it was time to end it. It must be hard to have to move though. Yes food can be delicious and healthy at the same time, I really like veggie burgers.

Veggie burgers are great! These are the kind of options I wanted to be able to eat, and now I can. Relationship control is so hard to see until you get out of the relationship. It is hard, but II have good friends who care about me. I will say that while I've always identified as bisexual, this relationship has really killed my interest in men. Maybe I'll start identifying as Lesbian going forward, because I doubt I'd date another man.

There are so many options now with both vegan options and relationship status. You really don't have to identify as anything anymore just be you. As long as you are happy with yourself how you identify shouldn't matter. I took a seminar on equality the other day it was very interesting there were so many terms I wasn't even aware of in the LGBQT++ community
Thank you, that really means a lot! It helps to hear that. How was the seminar? What did you learn?

The seminar was about equality but it was put on by some members of the LGBQT community. It was very interesting learning about people's experiences. Things are changing with the new generation they no longer identify as attracted to one specific gender and in the future things will change people will like people for who they are not what they identify as. I also learned that it is easy to make people feel more comfortable buy putting unisex bathroom signs on single stall bathrooms so people don't have to decide if they are male or female.

dialog.text: I got the kindest gift from one of the people on my mail route today!
Really!? What did they give you? Is it NASCAR related?
No, I am not sure if they know my dad used to drive. They got me a really nice gift certificate to a spa so I can relax. My job has been very hard on me lately.

Aww, that's really nice of them!  Do you think you'll be able to use it anytime soon?  I know you've been doing lots of overtime lately.  But if it helps, I can look after your dogs while you're at the spa.

I am planning maybe next weekend to use it and I was going to look for someplace for Barnaby to go. That would be great if you could watch him for me! He loves when you take him on walks with your dogs.
Yeah definitely! I love dog walking and the more the merrier!  If it's okay with you, maybe I could take the group to the dog park?  Would Barnaby like that?
Yeah Barnaby gets along with all kinds of dogs. Just make sure you watch out for scorpions! I can't stand those things, and Barnaby gets jumpy around them too.

Okay, I will be extra cautious about the scorpions! I've never had issues with them, but I know their venom can be really harmful.  In fact, if the song Rock You Like a Hurricane is playing at the park I'll turn right around and keep the dogs in the car.

Probably a good idea. Well thank you very much for offering to watch my dog. I think it'll be great to get away for a while and forget about the stress of delivering the mail. Especially since we had to start delivering on Sundays now too!

Like I said, it's no problem and I'm happy to do whatever I can to help you reduce the amount of stress in your life.  How have your parents been doing lately?  Have you talked to them about your work?

My dad's enjoying his retirement from NASCAR. He still goes on the road sometimes to do signings and meet with the fans. My mom stopped selling AVON but she can still order me what I need if I ask her. She gets me this eye shadow I really like.

That's great! I'm not big into makeup, but it seems like a nice perk to have a mom that can get you what you like.  I wish my parents could hook me up, but the stuff my dad sells isn't useful to me at all, haha

Absolutely! I always have fun hanging out with them, they are amazing. Speaking of dogs, do you have anything interesting planned with your dog this summer?
Hmm not really, we will stick to daily walks.
Haha, well daily walks are always fun. Maybe we can join you some of these days, go on a group dog walk?
yes that would be fantastic! It would be nice for my pup to have more friends too.
Oh I agree, mine will absolutely love it too! I can already imagine their excitement. Perhaps we can combine it with a dinner? You can teach me how to make some of your delicious veggie burgers!
oh yes, i found a really good recipe. they're almost as good as cheeseburgers.
Terrific! Eating burgers and hanging out with all of the pets sounds pretty good to me. I can tell you about some of my more unruly students, I have some pretty interesting stories!
yes, we should meet before you go off on your roadtrip. Oh, tell me more about those unruly students. I remember some students when i was a teacher, complete monsters!
Right some kids just have too much energy if you ask me! I will tell you more about them when we meet, but lets just say lots of running is involved and during class time non the less.

dialog.text: As a child we were poor, so I spend most time volunteering at a soup kitchen.
Did you have to do any hard chores?
No, but I used to be a gym teacher. I am now retired. What do you do?
I am a school teacher and I love children and my job.
That's lovely. Do you like cheeseburgers? They're my favorite.
Not really as a women I try to watch my diet at all times.
I am a woman, but you know, life is short.
True but I like to try to keep my figure down.
As do I, which is why I exercise.
The most exercise I do is walking my dogs
I love dogs. What kind do you have?
I have a hound and a pitbull. And I love them very much.
I've a miniature pincer. He's huge. He might eat too many cheeseburgers.
Wow you feed your dogs burgers that cant be good for them!
I also have 3 cats. One is indoors. The other two like to stay outside.
With to dogs I can't have any cats in the house.

personas: I own an outdoor cat that is currently missing.
I go to a soup kitchen.
I own another cat that is not missing at the moment.
I am a retired teacher.
I was excited and motivated to teach in the past.
I own puppies.
I am a currently a teacher in a school.
I am excited about summer break.
I enjoy teaching students.

dialog.text: One of my outdoor cats went missing!
Oh no!!!   What can I do to help?  Have you put up flyers?
Yes, some of the people at the soup kitchen and I made some flyers and posted them at several places. Oh I'm just beside myself. How are your pups? I hope they are all accounted for!
They are - right in my sight sound asleep on the sofa.  I bet that you are besides yourself with worry.  Can I call aournd at the shelters for you?
I've already been calling and they have her picture. Little claws has people looking out for her. I greatly appreciate your willingness to help! It sure is a comforting feeling!

I just know that if I was in your postion, I would want all the help I could get until my baby came home.  I feel so badlya nd can only pray she makes it home safely.  Maybe you can watch the other cat and see if it leads you on a trail to her?
Possibly, that's a great idea! Well, besides all that excitement, how
How am I?  Doing good, ready for the school year to be over. As a retired teacher, I am sure that you know that feeling!

Yes, that's exactly what I was going to ask you! Sorry I hit the return button on accident! Oh Lord yes! I can totally relate! It can be a little overwhelming towards the end of the year! But the most exciting part about it getting ready for a new group of kiddos!
I'll be excited about it after the summer break  :)
I always was excited and ready to teach! You meet some interesting characters teaching...some can be a little tough to break but I've always had a way with the tough kids@
I so enjoy seeing their faces light up when they totally get what I am teaching them

personas: Yesterday I got a call that someone has my cats. I am planning to go pick the cat up tomorrow.
I was worried when my cat was gone, but now I am relieved he's been found.
I used to be a gym teacher.
I plan to relax with my cats and grill out at my home this summer.
I have a pitbull. I lost her once but found her later that day.
I am planning on taking my dogs on a road trip with me.
I am vegetarian.

dialog.text: Yesterday, I got a call from a person that said they have my cat. They are currently taking care of them in their home. I am planning on going to their house tomorrow, and bringing my cat back home.
Yay!! So glad to hear that. Where did they find your cat?
It was just outside their house. It was probably lost and homesick. I was so worried while he was gone, but the call I got really was a relief.
I'm sure he was, thankfully he's safe now. Has this ever happened before with him? Or with any of your other pets?
Not where they were gone that long. They are always home for supper and feeding time. Did your dogs ever get lost from home before?
That makes sense, I wonder what happened this time? And yes! My pitbull started chasing a cat one time and I couldn't keep up with her. I found her later that day. It was so stressful!
I believe it. I bet your dogs are going to be so happy when your home for summer break.
Definitely. I'm actually planning on taking them on a roadtrip with me! It'll be their first roadtrip :)
Sounds like fun. When I was a gym teacher I looked forward to summer break every year, I hope you make the most of it.
Are you planning anything for the summer?
Just relaxing with my cats and grilling out at home. You should come over when you aren’t on your road trip and I can make us cheeseburgers. My secret recipe.
I'd love to, but I'm actually a vegetarian! So I'll have to pass on the cheeseburgers. I'm sure they're delicious though.

personas: I can cook veggie burgers for dinner.
I really like cheeseburgers.
I have cats. My cats do not like veggie meat.
I help out at a soup kitchen.
I am an average cook.
I have dogs.
I love walking dogs.
I am going on a road trip to the west side of the state.

dialog.text: I actually found vegetarian and vegan-safe burgers made of plants that we could have for dinner if you'd like.
That sounds great. Sometimes there are only one or two brands that are decent, compared to beef, ham, etc. Have you tried them yet?
Yes, I really enjoyed them. Do you have a lot of good vegetarian recipes?
In between work and maintaining my place, my cooking skills are average at best. Although there are a few decent meals. There's a great vegetarian bacon, that goes well with cheddar. How about you?
I try and mix in a few every now and then, but I really like cheeseburgers, so I tend to throw a little meat in the diet. How are your dogs doing?
Oh I love those little dogs, and they keep me busy to be sure! Great at snuggles on the couch though. I'm so grateful to have them.  Wonder if the cats like veggie meat?
They prefer the real stuff, for sure. I've tried to give them little veggie snacks and they don't like them at all. They are true hunters.
Also, dogs and cats have such a keen sense of smell. We smell a few hundred scents, they can smell thousands, some dogs. We'll just have to be mindful of their health! Love walking the dogs.
Where are you planning on going on your roadtrip?
Planning on the west side of the state, still researching locations. Nice to have a little fun to look forward to! Curious how your soup kitchen work has been ?
It has been going well. We have had a lot of volunteers coming in, so I have had a lot of help.
It feels great when there's enough support, and you can see the difference in the people you serve! Good job!

dialog.text: I bought some seaweed to try during my grocery rounds and im loving it!
Really! Why did you decide to try it?
Well you know, it's always nice to try some new stuffs when you're bored. And I heard that seaweed is nutritious. Have you tried any new food recently?
Yes, but here's a secret... I had kale for the first time yesterday and I wasn't really a fan.
haha that's many people's first reaction. Kale alone doesn't taste good at all, but I heard baked kale chips taste good if you want to take a second try
Do I buy them or make them myself?
You can buy them or make them yourself, it depends on you, but I'd say it's easier to just buy them. I tried some before and it's pretty good, I like them.
Okay, I'll try it out. Would you say those chips are good for the nutrition, too? If so, it might be helpful for the training, right?
They are but I would still classify them as more or less healthier "junk food". For you training, it's best to get high protein food like milk and meat.
Good to hear. Have you ever had meat yourself?
No since my family is vegetarian so I grew up vegetarian. But I have tried mock meat like the beyond hamburger which is really good
Wow, but steak is so good! Like you said, I feel like it helps a lot with the protein for wrestling.

I am great. I went for a run earlier. Marathon, you know?
I've never done a marathon. I should try it. How many have you done?
My husband just convinced me to run my first. He has run 3 this year alone.
That's great. I help out at the homeless shelter. It is very fulfilling.
Giving back to the community is a very selfless thing to do. Good for you!
Thanks, I like people. I think most of them are good, so I try to help.
That's a great attitude to have. I believe you are right. Do you have any hobbies?
I spend most of my time with my job and helping people. Do you have any hobbies?
Sports, cooking only vegetarian meals, though, spending time with my husband
I couldn't do vegetarian. I need a lot of protein for my body

How do you control the gas? I do like beans, just not too many.
After awhile, your body gets used to it.
What is your favorite meal?

dialog.text: I've been making some really great vegetarian recipes lately if you'd like me to share them with you.
That sounds great since its hard for me to think of vegetarian foods I could make.
Great!  I'll email them to you. Also, I think that you could double and triple the recipes to serve at the shelter.  Beans can go a long way
Yeah it's always nice to have new recipes to serve at the shelter maybe I will suggest it next I help out.
Doesn't hurt to make a suggestion, for sure.  I bet that you meet a ton of interesting people at the shelter and while wrestling
Yep there is always interesting stories and you get to meet a lot of different people. How has your training been going for your first marathon?
Gruling for sure.  The first few miles are rough and then you get into a rythm.  But towards the end, I'm feeling it for sure!
That sounds tough but I would be open to the idea of running a marathon especially if its for an important cause.
The marathon I am training for is to support a local dog rescue group.  My husband has done 3 already this year, so I figured I can train and get this done!!
That sounds like great motivation knowing that you will be helping something you care about.
Exactly...  Helps to keep me motivated for sure!!
I imagine your husband has been a great source of motivation too since he has done 3 marathons this year.

dialog.text: Are there any local marathons you could take part in?
Yeah there's one coming up in September but I think that might be too soon to commit - maybe waiting until next year would be better. What do you think?
I think thats a wise decision. You will have more time to train and get into the sport of it.
That's what I'm thinking too - I guess I could always go for a half marathon this year, I've already got up to 10km or so on my runs. Have you ever ran a half?
Not yet. I think I might though to get a feel for what they are like and what my actual pace will be.
That's a good idea - I love the idea of it but I'm worried if I try too soon I'll fail and it will put me off sticking with marathon training
I think that perhaps participating in a walk marathon or half marathon might get you past those fears. I did one on my own and it wasnt that bad. Thats why I'm training for them now.
Maybe! It's a big commitment either way even if it is only a half marathon. Has your husband been helping you with your training?
He has. He goes out on his short morning run and takes me with him. He goes slower so I can keep up.
That's so good to have a running buddy who can help you. I love going out on my own so I can just listen to my music and clear my head when I'm running
I love it for that too. Its so nice to be able to get all my energy out.
100% sometimes when I start my long runs I think why do I do this to myself? But then I get into my groove and by the end of it I feel such a natural high!

dialog.text: I heard of a program that helps people acclimate their runs and increase them to the point where they are running half marathons.
What is the name of the program?
Run 'til You Drop: 15 Steps Towards Self-Actualization.
How long do you think it will take to reach your goal?
My husband and I have been steadily increasing our morning runs. I'm pretty close to the half-marathong level now.  I still have 3 months to train for the marathon though, so I think it's going well.
Ok you guys should definitely be ready by then. Is your goal to win it or just run in it?
Oh, my goal is just to finish it!  My husband will probably try to get in the top 10, but for me it's just knowing that I did it the first time.
That's a great goal! Have you ever thought about being vegan?
Yes indeed.  I like having dairy in my diet, and use a lot of milk in the recipes I cook.
Dairy is hard to give up. I use plant milk in my recipes.
It is hard to give up.  The protein is important.  I don't think I could do without it.
Milk is not the only source of protein. Would you eat seaweed? It's packed with protein.

dialog.text: I had the worst nightmare last night! The scarecrow from Jeepers Creepers was at the end of my bed! I woke up panicking.
Oh my god that must be frightening!! Did you watch too many horror movies yesterday?
I didn't! All it took was one scary commercial. That's how much of a wuss I am. I can't handle anything! I will cuddle with my cat to feel better.
Haha that's funny that it's just a commercial, I'm sorry that you had the scary nightmare but I can't help but literally laughing loud. By the way how are your cats doing?
i know, i know, i wish i could handle scary things. i don't know how people do it!! my cat is doing very good. so spoiled. how about yours? do they actually get along and play together?
Oh no I hope they can get along. Paris wants to play with Wiggles, but Wiggle always just attack Paris with his paws. I think they just need more time together.
cats are so funny that way. you can never predict what they will do. that's why i like them, such fun personalities. much better than dogs, i think. did you ever have dogs?
Nah two cats are enough for me to handle, adding a dog will drive me crazy haha. And I'm a cat person, I enjoy their unpredictability too even though that can cause me some troubles.

yes, i agree, they definitely can be trouble makers! i have had a dog before too and they demand a lot more attention and take a lot of time and energy. can be good, if that's what you are looking for.  how has your son been lately?

That sounds really nice. It is nice to make a difference. That's why I like human resources - to help people.

That's a lovely lesson to be teaching your child! For me it's been the opposite; my stepson has been guiding me towards being a more helpful person. Our bond is one I never thought I'd have, but now that he's in my life, I don't know what I'd do without him.

They do get a bad rap at times, but it is not their fault. You cannot generalize everyone.
I agree! I see these young people performing kind acts every day; it's really uplifting.

dialog.text: What kind of cats do you have?

I have one Russian Blue male and the rest are all plain domestic shorthairs. One is an orange male, one is a black female, and one is an absolutely enormous 20-pound tabby male. How is your job search going? Are you looking for a medical job?
Wow that's so many! How do they get along? My job search its going well, I got a couple of offers from doctor's offices. My wife got a job though, so our financial situation its less volatile.

They all get along really well, they've been together since they were very young. They're all former strays. Three of them (the shorthairs) are all sixteen so it's like a kitty nursing home in here sometimes, haha. I'm glad the job search is going well, and that the financial situation is more stable. It's so stressful to be short of money!

Good on you for rescuing strays! Are you going to rescue more, since some are getting older? And it is such a relief. I was worried we were gonna have to explain to your daughters why her moms were so stressed, but I think she doesn't know we were broke for a bit. She is too young to have to hear about family budget issues.

We are going to try to take some time off from cats for a bit after...well, you know. Nature takes its course. Vet bills for older cats are expensive since they need to go more often and need more testing. We're considering getting a puppy. Our two dogs now are rescues, but I had a Basset Hound that I raised from puppyhood til she died at 15, and I'm finally at the point where I can handle having another. I think it's a good idea to not let your daughter know about the money issues. Kids can really internalize stuff like that as being "their fault" somehow.

Yeah I can imagine it gets hard when they get old. A puppy might be a nice change of pace! We've been thinking about getting a kitten for our daughter now that life is more balanced out.  And I agree,  kids don't need to reach adulthood too early.
Kittens are great. I think they're actually better for kids than puppies sometimes because kittens will be more companionate and they're easier to care for - no walking!
Oh definitely! They're also more self sufficient,  so we don't need to constantly provide a kitten with attention.

Yes. And may I suggest, if you get two, it's not that much more expensive than one once shots are over with, and if the family is out for the day or on a weekend trip they can keep each other company.

That sounds smart. I've heard that cats do prefer to live together as bonded pairs, so once I choose which doctor's office I'm going to join and find my salary, we may look into getting two. It is. weird being an out of work doctor, but it does mean that once I get a job back we'll have more than enough money. My wife is making enough right now as a professor, but I want us to be financially comfortable.

Big enough for a WHOLE HOG barbecued, you betcha! (Or half a goat, I guess...we raise lots of animals even for ourselves) It doesn't have luxuries like ice dispensers though.

I like tomatoes, since they are easy to plant and I can make a lot of tomato juices from it. I really like tomato juice.
I like the radishes overall -- can plant'em between the slower growing crops as a marker, and don't need much soil for them anyways and they still grow so quickly.

dialog.text: Have you started the new job?

On my first night I had a few Bentleys and some other cars such as Ferrari's. It was cool yet quite nerve wracking at the same time. Don't want to damage anything.

Are they super comfy after wearing them for a few days?

Do you ever run any marathons?  I don't know how people can do that!  I wish I had that kind of stamina!  I always tell people, if you see me running, you should run too, because something is chasing us!

Oh that's not great to hear! I'm sure taking a few naps in the day may help your sleeping pattern. Do you work at night?

I do now. My new job as a valet at the casino is a night shift. It's not great for my lifestyle, but the tips are great. All these late-night gamblers drive expensive European cars. Speaking of which, what sports car do you fancy?

Wow, night shifts can certainly be challenging to get your head around, it can really affect your body with the change of sleeping pattern, so I can completely understand your struggles. Oh wow, I'd love to drive a Lambo aventador, that would be the dream. Just to see how fast I can go, see how much I can push the car to it's limits.

I've seen a Rolls-Royce, a few lambos, and this custom Bugatti they guy told me he bought with his winnings from roulette from this very casino! I bet the owners of this place are fuming every single time they see this guy drive in again with his flashy car. I wonder why he's not banned yet!
That's insane mate! I would of loved to see that. He must of won a lot to buy that car. It must be so frustrating seeing people like that winning just from luck

Yeah, it is. Meanwhile I'm over here parking his car and sacrificing my sleep over it. Hey, at least the guy tips well. He tosses me a $50 every time he rolls around. I guess I can't complain about that!

I can see how it can be but at least one day with all these big tips, you could maybe buy your own lambo or rolls royce. If people have money, and enough to gamble it, they're definitely going to tip well.
That's something to hope for, certainly! I don't think I'd jump straight into buying an expensive car, though. I don't trust my driving skills enough. Ironic, I know.

It's not as close as she wanted because the price of condos near the water is ridiculously high, but we managed to find one that's 20 mins bus ride away from the ocean and she likes it.

I know right like just why not?? It's not like gender is a big deal or some super secrets, but I guess it doesn't hurt to wait.

I still want to send you some of my homemade apple wine. It's delicious if I say so myself. While it has a fruity taste, it still packs a punch in terms of flavor and depth!
Oh my god that would be great! Thanks so much! I love trying homemade wines especially because they have more variations and reflect the owner's taste.

That would be great fun, thanks! Have you made any dessert or would you like me to bring some?
I haven't made any yet, would you mind? What do you think you'll bring?
I have a load of cooking chocolate so I might make chocolate brownies if you think that'll work for the other guests too?
That will definitely work, thank you! So are you getting ready for the hurricane? Are you nervous?

Great, I'll go for brownies then. We've got the house prepared as best we can for the hurricane, though luckily now it is looking like the worst of it won't be coming directly through our town. I'm a bit nervous but I've been through a couple of much worse ones before. Have you ever had to live through a hurricane?
I haven't. It seems like it would be a little nerve wracking. I'm glad that you are prepared for it. Have you had any luck on the job front?

I've applied for 5 jobs in the past week so just waiting to hear back. It can be a bit disheartening when I don't even get a response, but I'm going to get there in the end! What kind of job do you do at the moment?
I'm currently working as an assistant for a architecture firm. It's pretty interesting, but I'm always keeping my eyes open. We may have a few openings here, if you would like me to check.

That sounds really interesting, though I totally understand that you keep an eye out for other opportunities. If none of the jobs I've applied for come through I'd definitely appreciate you letting me know if any more openings become available there. I've got a lot of experience in all things admin!
I'm sure you would fit in great. We even have a company softball team and play in a local league. What position do you play?

dialog.text: Where do you think you will need to go when the hurricane gets worse?
I would probably go visit relatives that live away from the path of the hurricane. Have you experienced a hurricane before?

Yes I'm experienced quite a few. They can be a bit scary, but you have time to prepare for them which is a good thing. That's great that you have relatives to stay with in case you need to evacuate. Which relatives are they?
I have cousins that live the next state over. We usually visit them about once a year or they come see us. Do you live near a lot of relatives?
I live near my in-laws, but my siblings live a few states away in Tennessee.  Have you had any luck looking for new jobs?
No, for some reason I haven't been able to get callbacks. I think I am too nervous for interviews and it might not make a good impression.
Oh I'm sorry about that. I know it can be nerve-wracking looking for a new job. What kind of job would you prefer rather than the one you have now?
I want to work in either sports or entertainment. Those fields have always interested me. What about you? How is the job search going?
It's going well! I applied at a few burger places this afternoon and one of them called me a few minutes ago for an interview.
Congrats!! I hope you get the job. What burger place did you get the interview for?
It's a locally owned place called Freddie's. The manager there liked that I had previous experience in the food service industry as a line cook.
Is that the place with the steakburgers? I love the patties they serve. Now you are making me hungry lol.

dialog.text: I had a great conversation with my new friend, and he sounds all the more attractive to me. He definitely wants to get together for dinner and fun.
That's great. Good for you. Do you think they like to golf?
He is rather rich and interested in cerebral activities, so I would guess yes:) But the trouble is, maybe the people who like golf and the people who like putt-putt are mutually exclusive?
I imagine everybody likes to putt-putt? Have you ever met anyone that specifically said they do not like to putt-putt?

Well, I have to admit putt-putt is much less serious than golf, requires somewhat less diligence in body control, and is proud of all that! But in any case, any tips for navigating my new friendship...or love?
Oh, yeah. Just be yourself. Don't act any particular way that you wouldn't normally, because later on you'll regret having to always act a certain way that isn't really how you want to be.
I'm sure that is quite true. The reason my previous husband divorced, I feel, was that I was pressured to be either girly-girl or nerd too many hours of th day.

That's unfortunate. People should be able to just "BE" without having to "BE SOMETHING"... if you know what I mean? Like as long as you aren't hurting anyone you should have freedom to be how you want.
True also. Shower thought: maybe inviting my new friend out on the pickleball court would reveal his/her personality? Like spontaneity, ability to adapt to loss, sense of humor, all that I can see.

I think a hike or a canoe trip would do better in terms of getting to know someone. It's hard to converse when you are exerting yourself so physically and competitively. A nice relaxing canoe trip however provides ample space for conversation while simultaneously exercising and sharing experiences.

dialog.text: I won a gymnastics meet yesterday.
Wow congrats! I probably should have bet my money on you, I would have made some cash. What did you do to celebrate?

Thank you! I'm not sure that there are bookies who take bets on amateur women's gymnastics, but if you can find one, bet on me for sure! I went out with my gymnastics team to this classy, quaint Italian restaurant in our town.
That sounds delicious. I am not sure there is either, but I would for sure put money on you! How often do you practice your gymnastics?
I take it very seriously. We practice every day from Monday through Friday from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. after we get out of high school.
Wow, you are really committed. Do you ever get tired of it? That is a lot of hard work required for all that!
It is tough between going to school and practicing every day, but I love it! I know you feel the same way about grilling and chilling during the summer, right?

Absolutely. I eat, sleep, and breathe hanging out at the grill. Since I don't work anymore, I even grill sometimes in the winter, even though I do not enjoy it! But my love of grilling outweighs my hatred of the cold!
I love it. You have dedication to your "sport". What have you been grilling up lately? Since you like Italian, you should fire up some spicy Italian sausage to make with your lasagna!
Oh most definitely. I could go for that any day. Would your family like to join my wife and I for a grill out and some lasagna? Any special requests for sides?
Sure! When can I come over? I'd love it if you served that up with some buttery, savory garlic bread.
Well, whenever you aren't doing gymnastics I suppose. I am always home, but my wife works 11-6 Monday through Friday so come through any time on Saturday or Sunday!

dialog.text: When do you plan to go on another hair raising adventure

Of course! I am so proud of you! My go to lunch recipe is probably a bean burrito bowl! Brown rice, black and kidney beans, salsa, some vegan cheese and vegan sour cream, so delicious!

dialog.text: Was wondering if you might give me the name of the travel agent you used.
Athena Travel, I believe, with head offices in New York City.
That's great, thanks. I can't wait to go to Fiji. I am mostly looking forward to drinking the water there. It's the next stop after Barbados.

Sorry to burst your bubble, but a good amount of Fiji water mayyyyy have been bottled in your home country. But it would be a privilege to be accidentally sipping the water while snorkeling among the Barbados sunfishes.
Really? How can they get away with calling it water from Fiji if it's really just from Detroit or something?
Skillful marketing, I suppose. (Although I guarantee Athena Travel does deliver what it promises; not yet five star, but seamless.)
Is Athena Travel a Greek company by any chance?
No; it's American. But they do believe in gaining wisdom, not just pleasure, through travel just like Athena would have done.
Ahh. That's awesome! If I recall correctly, I believe Athens was the birthplace of democracy? Do you think democratic nations are more desirable vacation spots?
Hah! By and large they are, but to the extent that democracy is somewhat correlated with liberalism, cleanliness, and a lack of corruption -- but I would still recommend China.

I've actually been to China! I went to West Lake, Hangzhou, Beijing, and other places. Everyone there was so friendly I could not believe it. I really don't believe anything Americans say about China after going there. They're like the oldest nation on earth, after all. They probably have things down better than we do.
Their high speed trains are to die for! Also, if you like the Barbados beaches I can recommend Hainan Island or some unexplored parts of the Guangxi coast.

I never realized how exciting they are to watch, and the wrecks are crazy! Who's your favorite driver?
Hailie Degan is my favorite driver, she just is so cool and badass. where did you go for a walk?
I just walk up my subdivision to the gas station, buy a drink and walk back home. I try to walk everyday but sometimes I'm just to busy or the weather is bad. Did you have a good day at work?
Yea, so many people bought stamps, and one couple got their passports done.
That's cool, I didn't know you could get your passport at the post office. I need to get one soon for my next vacation.
where are you going on your vacation?
I'm thinking Bahama, they claim they have the most beautiful beaches. But I would also love to go to the Galapagos Islands, but that's pretty expensive. Have you ever been to a beach?

I have been to many beaches all over the US and I have never seen a scorpion. You should go, I think you would really enjoy it. Maybe we can plan a trip and I can show you my favorite beaches!
That dose sound fun. As long as they are dog friendly. I take my German Shepard with me where ever I go.

dialog.text: I got my pictures taken for my new passport.
Oh cool! Where do you plan to visit with your passport?
I have no idea at the moment. I am thinking an island somewhere for the good beaches. Maybe Fiji?
Nice! I have heard good things about Fiji. How soon might you go?

It will probably be a while yet. I don't think I'll be able to afford the Galapagos like I wanted, but I am just ready to go anywhere international now that I'm going to have a passport. I can't believe you don't love the ocean.

I have been afraid of the ocean for a long time because there can be so many different creatures in the water. I worry about islands because of the scorpions. I am thinking about traveling to the mid-west soon to see a Nascar race.
Your fear of scorpions must be really intense. I get it. Spiders terrify me. Now that I have seen a NASCAR race thanks to you, I would love to see one in person some day. I'll bet the energy is wild.

I've been to many NASCAR races ever since I was young because I used to go watch them in person to see my dad. They are always exciting and fun to see with a group of people. I hope to see Hailie Degan win a race in person some day too.
Have you ever seen a bad crash happen?
Yes, I once saw a crash where three people were injured. It slowed the race down for hours. However, they are very rare.
Oh, man. That's intense. I once saw a shark attack when I was at the beach. The guy lost his leg; there was a lot of excitement when the ambulances came.
That'd be too much for me. I love my legs and I know you do too. That's another reason I worry about going into the ocean or visiting beaches; there's a lot of terrifying wildlife in the waters

dialog.text: I think I found where I want to go on vacation!

I've never thought of that. Do you think those travel agents have my best interest in mind or how they can make the most money?

Well, I know there are some very trustworthy ones out there, but like with everything else in the world there are some bad ones.  Maybe you could check reviews online or ask friends if they've ever used one.
I'm guessing that means you've never used a travel agent huh? haha
Oh wait!  I have used one once.  Let me see if she's still in business and I'll let you know.. sorry, I totally forgot!!
